notes.title: Updated - Join the Party, Part 2 Patch - 7 AM PST (3 PM GMT) - December 6th, 2016
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/tocZST1.gif[/IMG]

[B]Update 3[/B] - 11 AM PST (7 PM GMT) - Hey folks, we're extending the downtime further while the team investigates a couple issues. Please bear with us. We will be back online as soon as possible. I'll post another update in one hour.

[B]Update 2[/B] - 10:30 AM PST (6:30 PM GMT) - We've completed all Windows updates and the patch is finishing up soon. Once that is done we will hop in and make sure everything is working before we open the servers back up. 

No specific ETA but I'll post another update in 30 minutes. Thanks for your patience!

[B]Update 1[/B] - 9:30 AM PST (5:30 PM GMT) - Greetings Trovians! Today's downtime required some Windows updates for our servers in addition to the normal patching process. Things aren't moving quite as quickly as we'd like so additional downtime may be needed. I don't have a specific ETA just yet, but expect another update from us in 60 minutes.

Hey all,

We're coming offline at 7AM PST (3PM GMT) for a patch on Tuesday. Get the Join the Party, Part 2 below!

Expected downtime is approximately 3 hours but we'll update this post if we're back online early or need some more time.

Thanks! 


[B][U]Join the Party Part 2[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*] The Party continues! Shadow Pinata Invaders are again dropping from the sky,  and now have a rare chance to drop Lively Launcher Wings. 
[*] Tysorion the Steward of New Beginnings has arrived! Spend your coins in the Join the Party events to get Trove's newest dragon!
[*] Celebratory Pin Heads now drop from Celebratory Pinatas!
[*] The hub has donned its winter coat, but the party is ramping up!
[/LIST]

[B][U]Special Effect Blocks[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*] There are 5 new craftable blocks in the fun factory that play special effects when you run over them or ride over them with a mag rider! They will also play any music blocks underneath them.
[/LIST]

[B][U]Store Updates[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*] Weekly Deals have arrived! Every week, a fantastic deal on certain items will appear in the store. Each deal can be purchased only once until it returns.
[*] Winter is here, and with it, Winter Pinatas!
[/LIST]

[B][U]Additional Updates[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*] Updated Hotbar to prevent "SHIFT" from being cut off.
[*] Crafting item name text field extended to prevent cut off.
[*] Updated the criteria for the featured club world portals in the hub so that none should ever be empty.
[*] 2 new Battle Arena maps have been added to the rotation.
[*] Reduced terraforming countdown from 25 to 10 seconds.
[*] Kills from spawned allies (Tombraiser's minions, Pirate Captain's "First Mate") will now start counting towards Defeat Enemies stat tracking.
[*] The Checked Off hat has reacquired its name in the tooltip.
[*] The Tech Table Segment recipe is no longer called the Tech Table Corner recipe. 
[*] If one person cancels out of the name change prompt, other players also contemplating a name change will not have their prompts disappear.
[*] Consuming Dragon Souls will now properly refer to the type of soul consumed.
[*] Added an internal cooldown to reduce /joinme spamming.
[/LIST]

notes.title: Turkeytopia – Stuffed With Thanksgiving Spirit
notes.content:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/11/Turkeytopia_blog.jpg[/IMG]

Turkeytopia returns to Trove, but this time it’s personal. The Dragonfire Peaks are alive with the sound of turkeys. These aggressive avians are in a fowl mood and the molten lava pits have them stewing in their own juices!

The techno-turkey invaders are more aggressive than ever and pack one heck of a wallop! 

[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/11/DreamGoblerFight.jpg[/IMG]

Survive the devastating knockback attack and take down the powerful poultry to earn [B]Turkey Stuffin’ Boxes[/B] for lots of seasonal loot.
[LIST]
[*]Pumpkins
[*]Glim
[*]Festive Turkeytopia hats
[*]Rare mounts
[*]13 seasonal recipes
[/LIST]

Take on all new Turkeytopia objectives to get into the holiday spirit. Gathering together in Trove beats IRL because we bring phat loot: Gem Booster Boxes, a Ninth Life Booster, 25 Diamond Dragonite, and more!

We have a mountain of new and classic Turkeytopia mounts available as well.

[LIST]
[*]Appeased Dream Gobbler crafted at the Turkeytopia Table from the Trotting Turkey mount
[IMG]http://webcdn.triongames.com/trove/img/AppeasedDreamGobbler.gif[/IMG]
[*]Roast Rider crafted at the Turkeytopia Table
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/11/RoastRider.gif[/IMG]
[*]Trotting Turkey rarely drop from Turkey Stuffin’ Boxes
[*]Springing Turkey rare loot from Uber difficulty Dream Gobblers
[*]Ready Roast crafted at the Turkeytopia Table
[*]Turbo Turkey magrider
[/LIST]

Take the fight to these turkeys, knock the stuffing out of them, and harvest up a veritable cornucopia of loot!

notes.title: Network Maintenance and Patch: November 21 at 11 PM PST
notes.content:
[IMG]http://webcdn.triongames.com/trove/img/PatchDay.gif[/IMG]

We are bringing Trove (and all Trion Worlds games) offline for network hardware maintenance tonight. This downtime is to address the [URL=http://steamcommunity.com/games/304050/announcements/detail/614007890977681748]hardware component of the recent disconnections and lag[/URL]. 

Following the network maintenance we'll be running our Tuesday Turkeytopia patch to get them both combined into one downtime.

We'll come offline at 11:00 PM PST (7 AM GMT) and total downtime should be approximately 4 hours.

Thank you for sticking with us!

[B][U]Turkeytopia[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*] There is a special series of objectives granting 5 gem booster boxes, an Empowered Gem box, 2 Battle Boxes, 5 Re-gemerators, a Ninth Life, and 25 Dragonite! But act quick; these only last for 2 weeks.
[*] The Wings of Unexpected Ascension are back! Any player who has purchased anything ever can get a free pair of turkey wings in the Store. If this is not you... there will never be a better deal!
[*] Shadow turkeys have invaded. These are now the normal invaders and can also be found in the Dragonfire Peaks. Defeat them, collect the box, and craft all new turkey themed mounts.
[*] The Hub has been redecorated for the Turkeytopia festivities! 
[/LIST]

notes.title: Join the Party!
notes.content:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/11/Jointheparty_blog.jpg[/IMG]

We’re working hard to bring Trove to the PlayStation 4 and Xbox One and it’s paying off! With so much to be thankful for we decided to share the love with all of you by throwing the Troviest parties of all - new invaders, new loot, new mounts, a new Hub, and more!

You don’t need to RSVP to this shindig, just play Trove and the party will come to you. 

[B]Join the Party Event Details[/B]

[B]New Pinata Invaders[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Don’t let these party animals fool you; they are here to beat down Trovians and chew bubble gum – but they’re all out of bubble gum.
[/LIST]

[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/11/PinataInvader.jpg[/IMG]

[B]Celebratory Pinatas[/B] 
[LIST]
[*]Defeat Pinata Invaders to collect Celebratory Pinatas. These drop a variety of loot including Pinata Coins and very rarely a new pinata mount. These rare mounts will be different for each invasion so don’t miss your chance to collect them all!
[*]These pinatas drop one Pinata Coin for everyone nearby but two coins for the player that throws the pinata. Team up with other Trovians to share the love with every pinata party!
[/LIST]

[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/11/InvaderWrath.jpg[/IMG]

[B]Piñata Coins[/B]
[LIST]
[*]A new type of party currency used to purchase awesome loot from a new Hub vendor, Pinates the Purveyor.
[*]Buy a Pinatataur mount for 1,000 Pinata Coins with more mounts coming in future Join the Party events!
[/LIST]
[B]Two New Quest Objectives[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Throw enough pinatas for a truly epic pinata party to earn three Empowered Gem Boxes.
[*]Destroy enough to unlock a free Ninth Life Booster!
[/LIST]

A good party has plenty of after parties and this one is no different. The celebration will return again and again. Join the party and celebrate Trove coming to the Xbox One and PlayStation 4!

notes.title: Updated Nov. 17th - Ongoing network connectivity issues
notes.content:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/05/launch.jpg[/IMG]

[B]Update 10 - November 21st, 6 PM PST:[/B]

We'll be switching over to the [URL=http://forums.trovegame.com/showthread.php?112480]new network hardware tonight at 11 PM PST[/URL] and will monitor server status very closely once we're back online. 

[B]Update 9 - November 17th, 1:00 PM PST (9:00 PM GMT):[/B]

Hi all!

Just a quick update on our progress. Our network team has done really great work to keep things running more smoothly over the last few days. We do still have occasional disconnects but we recover very quickly. The new router hardware is arriving this week and we'll start the process of getting everything hooked up and tested as soon as possible.

We are also working with third party Internet providers so we'll likely make the switch over to the new hardware on a weekday rather than bringing it online over the weekend (just to be sure to avoid any extended downtime).

We'll continue to update you with the latest as new info comes in. Thanks everyone!

[B]Update 8 - November 15th, 6:25 PM PST (2:25 AM GMT):[/B]

Thank you all for being so patient and understanding regarding the recent network connectivity issues. 

Over the last few days we've implemented several changes that have increased stability, though we're still working to address the underlying cause. 

Players will still be affected by the issue periodically. Getting this fix in place remains our top priority and we have very specific plans of action being implemented. In addition, we're putting together compensation packages for all of our games and will send those out once we've gotten the network issues resolved.

Keep an eye on this post for more updates in the days ahead.


[B]Update 7[/B] - 4:30 PM PST (12:30 AM GMT) - With the network connection issues over the last few days we know many of you are concerned with your Patron status or just lost time playing Trove. We agree that this has been a bad experience all around and we wanted to let everyone know the plan moving forward into the weekend.

[LIST]
[*]We're putting together compensation for everyone who has logged in since these issues started. This is something we'll provide to players once we've resolved the issue and everyone is able to get in and play normally.
[*]Until the network issue is completely resolved we will have ongoing disconnects. As we've mentioned, we'll do everything we can to get the game up and running as quickly as possible when we do come offline.
[/LIST]

Our network team is working to resolve these issues all day, even on weekends. If we do have disconnects, rest assured we're on it.

Getting these network issues resolve remains our top priority. Please hang in there a bit longer. 

Thanks all!

[B]Update 6[/B] - 3:20 PM PST (11:20 PM GMT) - We're restarting Trove servers in 10 minutes to reconnect to the network. We'll be back online as quickly as possible.

[B]Update 5[/B] - 1:20 PM PST (8:20 PM GMT) - While we work to resolve the connection issues we may bring the game online periodically. When we do this it is with the intention of allowing everyone to play normally, but there is a risk that the network may drop connection again. This is part of the process of getting the issue resolved, so please bear with us.

[B]Update 1[/B] - 10:45 AM PDT (6:45 PM GMT) - Our dev and network teams are continuing to work on resolving the root cause of the network issues. This is the highest priority for absolutely everyone at Trion Worlds. Thanks everyone. - Fasti

Greetings everyone,

We know the last two days of disconnects and downtime have hurt your gameplay, and we want you to know that our teams have been working as hard as possible to get everything back to normal. We’ve identified two network issues that are causing troubles for those of you connecting to our Dallas (North America) datacenter. One is a network equipment issue on our side, and the other is an Internet service issue outside of our network. Both of these issues happening simultaneously is leading to the unusual performance everyone has been recently experiencing.

We are incredibly sorry about this, and getting our network back to 100% is our #1 priority. We’re working with outside providers and our internal hardware teams to get both of these issues squared away. However, it is possible that these disconnects may continue to occur intermittently through the beginning of the weekend.

We’re making note of what customers are affected by this, and we’ll follow up with all of you once these issues have been resolved. Thanks for sticking with us through this, and we look forward to getting all of you back in the game!

Thanks for sticking with us through this, and we look forward to getting all of you back in the game!

Sincerely,
The Trove Team

notes.title: ONLINE - Connectivity Issues (Patch) - November 9, 2016
notes.content:
[IMG]http://webcdn.triongames.com/trove/img/PatchDay.gif[/IMG]

Update 2 - We're patched up and back online. Thanks everyone.


Update 1 - We're doing another restart to resolve the connection issues. With this unexpected downtime this evening [URL=http://forums.trovegame.com/showthread.php?111830]we're going to roll out the patch now[/URL]. Once the patch is completed we'll come back online with no downtime for tomorrow.

Hey folks,

We're aware of the current connectivity issues players are running into and our network folks are working to address it. There appears to be a hiccup in the connection between our network and an external ISP.

Please bear with us. 

Thanks!

[B][U]Updates[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*] Fixed bug where the tutorial objective resets for players the first time after they log in since Tuesday's patch. Unfortunately, a side effect of this fix is that anyone whose objectives were reset will get reset again. However, anyone who has not logged in since the patch will not get reset when they login.
[*] Fixed a few incorrect speed values on assorted sets of wings which were too slow.
[/LIST]

[QUOTE]Hey all, Avarem here. I wanted to drop a quick note about a few changes in this hotfix. 

First of all the primary reason for this is to reset (yes again) the tutorial objectives. These were corrupted in our last patch, causing a reset. The only way to prevent all additional players who log in from being similarly corrupted was to implement a fix that resets players who reached the corrupted and therefore reset state. We wanted to get this fix out before the weekend and our weekend warriors logged in for the first time since the patch. On the bright side, if you complete one or both of the join the party objectives before this update you should find that you can complete them again.

Secondly, we are removing the Yuge hairstyle from the game with this patch. What originally felt like a lighthearted joke now felt like something much more divisive and exclusionary. If you were using this hairstyle when you log in after the update you will now find yourself to be bald.[/QUOTE]

notes.title: Thallasion, Shaper of the Currents, Rules the Drowned Worlds
notes.content:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/11/Thallasion_blog.jpg[/IMG]

Just when you thought it was safe to go back in the water - Thallasion, Shaper of the Currents invades the Drowned World and he’s not just practicing the backstroke. Take down this wet and wild world boss to earn your very own Thallasion legendary dragon mount!

Reel in this acid-spewing terror from the deeps!

[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/11/ThallasionAcid.jpg[/IMG]

You’ll find Thallasian underwater in Drowned World biomes as a very rare spawn. If you’re able to find his submerged lair you can also take the fight right to him. 

The Shaper of the Currents was born of the sea and from the ocean he receives new life. He's being constantly healed by the water during the fight so you'll need a group of adventurers to take him down. Beware the powerful poison he spits – while it will rob you of your health it will rapidly heal Thallasion.

Collect enough Deep Sea Dragon Egg fragments when you take down this supreme sea serpent and you’ll be able to craft your very own Thallasion, Shaper of the Currents legendary dragon!

[IMG]http://webcdn.triongames.com/trove/img/media/ThllasionPose.gif[/IMG]

Unlocking Thallasion grants all of these permanent bonuses:

[LIST]
[*]250 Physical Damage
[*]1,800 Health Regeneration
[*]50 Magic Find
[/LIST]
You won’t need to fish for compliments on this legendary leviathan!

notes.title: Join the Party Patch - 9AM PST (5PM GMT) November 8th, 2016
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/tocZST1.gif[/IMG]

Hey folks,

We're coming offline on Tuesday, November 8th to release the [URL=http://forums.trovegame.com/showthread.php?111730]Join the Party patch[/URL].

Downtime will start art 9AM PST (5 PM GMT) and will last approximately 90 minutes. If we're back early or need a bit more time we'll update this notice.

Thanks!

[B][U]Join the Party![/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*] The party is here! New piñata invaders drop party coins and a new pinata. These pinatas drop more coins and a new mount!
[*]  Spend coins in the hub to earn a new mount. The party will return in the future with even more mounts to be unlocked for coins.
[*]  There are two new pinata-themed objectives to go along with the event.
[/LIST] 

[B][U]Thallasion, Shaper of the Currents[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*] Another rare and mysterious dragon has descended upon Trove! The great and ancient aquatic wyrm Thallasion now resides within the deep!
[/LIST]

[B][U]Steam Workshop[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*] Tag support was added to the Trove Workshop. Check out the new tags parameters for mod and workshop commands. 
[*] Tags embedded into mods are now merged with tags from the Workshop when mods are loaded at startup. 
[/LIST]

[u][B]It's YUGE![/B][/u]
[LIST]
[*] New Yuge Hairstyle has been added.
[/LIST]

[B][U]Promo Mastery Adjustments[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*] We've removed mastery rewards from the alpha cosmetics as well as the dev hat, mod hat, and creator's hat. We want the pursuit of max mastery to be an even playing field and these items are not planned to be available again soon, if ever.
[*] The Rascal Raptor, Eggnog, and Baby Punchbot are now in the 'Promo' tab in collections
[/LIST]

[B][U]Additional Updates[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*] Brazilian translation treasures are now live. These don't grant mastery but they show off that you helped out! Will arrive for other players in the future. 
[*] Fixed bug where stats weren't set correctly in Battle Arenas without changing your class.
[*] Many multi-threading crash and UI fixes. 
[*] Contest rewards in the claims window now show when they expire. 
[*] Fixed bug where Scintilla, Spark of the Sky didn't provide movement buff to others.
[*] Fixed bug where marketplace comparisons didn't work when flux was the selling currency.
[*] Fix rare crash that occurs when disconnected while entering a different world. 
[*] Town portal tooltips now have complete names.
[*] Loot Collecting dragon egg fragments now gives 400 flux (down from 500).
[/LIST]

notes.title: Movember Reign
notes.content:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2015/11/Movember.jpg[/IMG]

November is such a magical time of year! A time that brings together family and friends to reminisce about the year behind us and the year to come. More than anything else it’s a time to rock a sweet, sweet ‘stache!

Through the month of November you can visit the Trove Store and pick up a Movember Pack for just 100 Cubits! That’s no typo, a cool one hundred Cubits and all of these goodies are yours:
[LIST]
[*]7 distinct blocks
[*]5 face options that show off your mustachioed mug
[*]A Mustache Mag Rider for surfing in style
[/LIST]
This Movember you mustache yourself one important question: how much facial hair can one screen shot hold? Let's put that to the test! Post your mustachioed mug shots using #Movember. 

*We’re not affiliated with the Movember Foundation, but you can help them promote men’s health [URL=https://us.movember.com/about/foundation]one mustache at a time right here[/URL].

- 5 face options that show off your mustachioed mug
- A Mustache Mag Rider for surfing in style

notes.title: Dragon Hoard Pack - A Treasure Beyond Measure
notes.content:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/10/DragonPackOct_blog.jpg[/IMG]

The word “dragon” comes from an ancient Greek term “draconta,” which meant “to watch.” Since the first stories of dragons were told they have been watchful guardians over the world’s greatest treasures. The Dragon Hoard Pack is among the greatest caches of wealth anywhere!

[IMG]http://webcdn.triongames.com/trove/img/Inora.gif[/IMG]

[list]
[*][B]Inora, Flame of Enlightenment[/B] – A full legendary dragon of tremendous grace and unwavering power. Unlocking this mythical beast will grant all your classes a series of permanent boosts:
  [list=1]
  [*]10% Maximum Health
  [*]3% Attack Speed
  [*]+500 Physical Damage
  [*]+50 Magic Find
[/list]
[*]333 [B]Dragon Coins[/B] to speed up the unlocking of another dragon.
[*]33 [B]Greater Dragon Caches[/B] that may contain Dragon Coins, Dragon Souls that can be used or traded, or a variety of rare Dragon Eggs.
[*]3 [B]Diamond Dragonite Pouches[/B] that will help you progress toward unlocking your very own Diamond Dragon Egg used in crafting Primordial Dragons!
[/list]

A treasure this magnificent comes but once in a lifetime. Don’t let it slip through your fingers. It's available on the Trove Store now using your Steam Wallet!

[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/10/ShadowseEve_Bonus_blog.jpg[/IMG]

[B]Update 4[/B] - For the small number of people who still haven't received the items yet, we'll need a bit more time, but you'll be taken care of. I'll keep this thread updated. Anyone logging in for the first time today will receive all items normally.

[B]Update 3[/B] - Everyone who logged in after the start of the event should have the 25 Shadow's Eve chests and the Ninth Life booster now. Restart the game if you're not seeing it. Post below if you signed in after 4AM PDT but have not received the items. Thanks all!

[B]Update 2[/B] - We've got a fix for the missing rewards internally and plan to roll that out soon. That will allow anyone who signs in after the update to get the rewards. For players who already signed in we will be granting the rewards to you separately, but they will be sent out. 

[b]Update 1[/b] - Hey folks, we're aware that the rewards have not been granted and we're working to get that fixed now. Thanks for your patience!

Shadow’s Eve is driving toward a crescendo! Join us for a 24 hour Friday Fright Fest before the holiday is driven back into darkness for another year. 

This scary good login event is full of free bonuses and frighteningly epic loot that starts at [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=4:00+AM+PDT+October+28+2016]4AM PDT (11 AM GMT) on October 28th[/URL]!

Spread the word that the Friday Fright Fest is taking login bonuses to a whole new level!
[LIST]
[*]A free [B]Ninth Life Gem Booster[/B]!
[*]25 [B]Shadow’s Eve Daily Loot Chests[/B] (and 25 chance at the Phantataur mount).
[*][B]Double XP[/B] all day that stacks with Patron status.
[*]Enjoy 200 bonus [B]Superstition[/B] (for those who aren’t afraid of ghosts).
[/LIST]
It’s a dead man’s party as Shadow’s Eve slips back into the darkness from whence it came. Take advantage of a stack of scary-good perks!

notes.title: Trove mods come to the Steam Workshop!
notes.content:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/10/ModSystem_blog.jpg[/IMG]

Trove’s modding community is one of our greatest assets. The creativity and passion shown by so many players allows endless customization and limitless imagination! To better support you, and your creations, we’re proud to bring modding to the Steam Workshop.

Mods are creations made by other players that allow you to customize how items in game look. There are mods for weapons, costumes, allies, mounts, and dragons! 

Here is our Drumsticks mount, as it appears in game:
[img]http://webcdn.triongames.com/trove/img/Drumsticks.gif[/img]

Here it is with the Ignerius, the Firebringer mod skin:
[img]http://webcdn.triongames.com/trove/img/Ignerius.gif[/img]

Placing community created mods into Trove has never been easier with the Steam Workshop! 

[b]Steam Workshop[/b]

Visit the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/304050/workshop/]Trove Workshop[/url] to browse through player-created mods. As you browse, you can rate them with a thumb’s up or thumb’s down, mark the mod as a Favorite, share a link to it on social media, and Subscribe to the mod.

Subscribing to a mod allows you to download and install it for use the next time you launch Trove. Disable a mod by pressing the [b]Esc[/b] key, clicking the [b]Mods[/b] button, then the [b]Disable[/b] button for that specific mod. To remove a mod completely, Unsubscribe from it on the Workshop and it will be removed from your game files fairly quickly.

[b]Mod Creators[/b]
To learn about the basics of creating your own mods please take a look at our TroveCreations Subreddit.

You can share a previously created .tmod file (new mod format), or a brand new mod, directly to the Workshop while in game. To get started make sure you launched Trove via Steam and your mod shows up in your Mods menu.

[b]Uploading a Mod[/b]
Use this command to upload a new mod or make changes to an existing mod: 
[LIST]
[*]/workshop upload title="the name of your mod" changes="any comment to describe the mod"
[/LIST]

You’ll see upload progress announcements in your combat text log on the right side of the game window. If there are any issues you’ll get an error message explaining the problem. 

Once the upload completes successfully the Steam overlay will pop up with the URL to view your mod in the Workshop. On that page you can add additional info about your mod or share it on social media.

For more info on uploading your own mods to the Workshop [url=https://www.trovesaurus.com/page=1883/sharing-your-tmod-on-steam-workshop]check out this guide on Trovesaurus.[/url]

Enter a world of limitless possibilities with Trove mods!

notes.title: Loot Collector, Vault Clubs, & Steam Workshop Patch - 7AM PDT (2PM GMT) October 25, 2016
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/tocZST1.gif[/IMG]

Hey folks,

We're coming offline on Tuesday, October 25th to release the Loot Collector, Vault Clubs, and Steam Workshop patch.

Downtime will start at [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7AM+PDT+October+25+2016]7AM PDT (2PM GMT)[/URL] and should last approximately 3 hours.
Thanks!

Patch Notes

[B][U]Loot Collector[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*] The revamped loot collector UI is now live!
[*] It now represents all your loot collectable items at once in an easy to parse list view and has the following additional new features:
[*] Lock items to prevent them from being easily loot collected.
[*] Collect all button for quickly collecting all non-locked loot.
[*] Buy back - up to 150 items you've collected within the last 24 hours will be available to buy back.
[*] Quickly identify new styles you have yet to unlock.
[/LIST]

[B][U]Vault Clubs[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*] You can now create Vault Clubs! 
[*] Vault Clubs have 15 more storage slots in both the normal and officer club chests, but do not have modifiable worlds. The Vault worlds have a rejuvination station, trading post, loot collector, personal chest, club chest, and officer chest.
[*] Club Cards are no longer tradable.
[*] Club Cards are now more expensive to craft.
[/LIST]

[B][U]Steam Workshop[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*] The Steam Workshop is now available for Trove Mods!
[*] It's easy to use! Do you use Steam and want to know how to use it? [URL=https://www.trovesaurus.com/page=1893/installing-mods-from-steam-workshop]Check out this handy player guide[/URL].
[*] Are you a mod maker and want to upload your mod? [URL=https://www.trovesaurus.com/page=1883/sharing-your-tmod-on-steam-workshop]Check out this guide[/URL].
[/LIST]

[B][U]French and German Languages[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*] French and German are no longer considered in Beta!
[*] Trove will now display in the language you've selected for Glyph if it is one of these languages.
[*] Users who have selected French or German for their language in Trove are now placed in separate French and German instances of Global Chat.
[/LIST]

[B][U]Animal Helms![/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*] Omni unlockers are now known as 'Stashes'. 
[*] There are now stash exclusive animal helm styles in their own style category. Super Style Stashes will unlock these randomly!
[*] Twixler made all these so make sure to let her know how much you like them if you see her.
[/LIST]

[B][U]Shadow’s Eve[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*] Oct 28 is going to be especially spooky! Log in to receive a Ninth Life booster, 25 Shadow's Eve Daily Reward Chests, and double XP all day. Are you seeing what I'm seeing? You must be extra superstitious...
[*] Pumpkin harvesting dungeons now rarely appear in the Cursed Vale to supplement your Pumpkin income!
[/LIST]

[B][U]Dragons[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*] Inora, Flame of Enlightenment, is now live! Designed by GYNLBart.
[*] Acquire the egg for Inora from the Merchant of Wonders.
[/LIST]

[B][U]Store[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*] The Dragon Horde pack is now live! Pick up this pack for a tradable version of Inora, 33 greater dragon caches, 333 dragon coins, and 3 diamond dragonite pouches.
[*] The Essentials Pack is a bit more Gem-tastic! Instead of 20,000 Cubits, this pack now grants 50 Gem Booster Boxes, a slight increase in value.
[/LIST]

[B][U]Interactions[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*] You can now interact with objects without directly targeting them. When you get near an interactable object, its tooltip appears and you can press E to interact with it. Don't worry - you can still target objects directly, too.
[*] Players and NPCs no longer block your interactions when they are standing between you and the object you are trying to interact with.
[*] Tooltips for interactable objects no longer appear when you are outside of interaction range.
[/LIST]

[B][U]Battle Arenas[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*] Battle Arena quick matches now grant class experience upon completion.
[*] Quick matches and club matches now award star bar points upon completion.
[/LIST]

[B][U]Community Content[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*] The new Bonecutter X-2 mount by Spree and Stealth545 will soon be available!
[/LIST]

[B][U]Additional Updates and Fixes[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*] We've smoothed the experience curve to level 30 and reduced the amount of experience required from level 20-30.
[*] World tooltips now appear more quickly.
[*] Renamed the style vault categories: Hat Style Vault, Mask Style Vault, etc to simply "Vault". These strings are only used in Collections (when you have already selected Hats, Faces, etc) and in the redesigned Loot Collector.
[*] Non-tradable patron coins and Daily Reward Chests are no longer loot collectable.
[*] Disabled loading into museum worlds.
[*] Radiant Auras no longer disappear when viewed from any angle.
[*] Fixed bug where you couldn't invite non-friends to join you in a world.
[*] The level up text for the Chloromancer when reaching level 3 has been fixed.
[*] Fixed underflow bug in club UI.  
[*] Fixed bug where contest reward progress meter didn't show in Leaderboard UI. 
[*] Fixed a bug which could cause the intro video to play at the wrong resolution.
[*] Fixed z-fighting issue with rendering transparent blocks underwater. 
[*] Fixed bug where progress could be made toward event objectives before they were active.
[*]Added a client tool, Trove.exe -tool extractmod to extract the contents of a tmod file to the local filesystem
[*]Added -override option to Trove.exe -tool extractmod that ensures all files in the ouput are within "override" folders.
[*]Added an option to output a yaml file that can be used to rebuild a .tmod file to Trove.exe -tool extractmod
[/LIST]

notes.title: Shadow's Eve Patch - 7AM PDT (2PM GMT) October 4, 2016
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/tocZST1.gif[/IMG]

Hey folks,

We're coming offline on Tuesday, October 11th to release the Shadow's Eve, Mods, and Dragonite Patch.

Downtime will start at [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7AM+PDT+October+11+2016]7AM PDT (2PM GMT)[/URL] and should last approximately 90 minutes.

[U][B]Shadow's Eve is Back and Even Better![/B][/U]

[*] Pumpkin Dungeons are sprouting in all biomes!  Find a giant Jack-O-Lantern and defeat these spooky intruders for candy corn.
[*] The Hub is all Shadow’s Eve themed, and includes the Shadowy Station (inside a big pumpkin) where candy corn can be used.
[*] You can craft and grow pumpkins once more!
[*]The [B]Spookytime Mystery Box[/B] is now available at the Shadowy Station.  It contains seasonally haunting recipes and the new [B]Hyperactive Haunt[/B] and [B]Bouncy Black Bat[/B] mounts.
[*] The [B]Sugar Crasher[/B] and [B]Spirited Broomstick[/B] are added to the Shadowy Station as craftable, tradeable mounts. 
[*] Log in every day for a Shadow’s Eve Daily Reward Chest.  This replaces the Daily Reward Chest for the duration of the Shadow’s Eve event, but fear not, you have the same chances of getting rare drops as ever.  As an uncommon drop, you may receive [B]Pennry's[/B]  [B]Phantataur[/B] mount!
 [*] The Phantataur is also available for credits during the event (although honestly, log in every day and you'll almost certainly get one), as is the returning [B]Caskart Mag Rider[/B].
 [*] Craft the Drak-O-Lantern Dragon Egg or pick it up in the new pack!
 [*] Some new event objectives are now live! Once you complete the Diamond Dragonite objective these will appear (or once that one expires next week). Complete them all to earn 10 Lapis Luckbugs, 3 Empowered Gem Boxes, and the unique [B]Bitten Kitten[/B] mount!
[*] Spooky things are afoot. And afloat. Do you see ghosts? How suspicious.
[*] This event will run through the end of October and culminate with a special bonus Ninth Life just for logging in on October 28th!
[/LIST]

[U][B]Simplified Modding[/B][/U]
[LIST]
[*] It's now easier than ever to use community created mods to enhance your game!
[*] Simply place '.tmod' files into the new 'mod' folder in your Trove installation directory to mod your game.
[*] Enable and disable your added mods via the ESC menu in-game.
[*] Want to make a mod? Check out this great guide: [url]https://www.trovesaurus.com/page=1857/new-mod-file-instructions-tmod-files-made-easy[/url]
[/LIST]

[U][B]Diamond Dragonite[/B][/U]
[LIST]
[*]You can now craft a Diamond Dragon Egg at the Dragon Crucible using Diamond Dragonite!
[*] Diamond Dragonite can be obtained via the new daily contest for total power rank, events, and also a very very rare tradable world drop 'Diamond Dragonite Pouch'. 
[*] For this week only there is a new limited time objective. Complete 25 challenges (each stage counts for 1) and earn 50 extra Diamond Dragonite!
[/LIST]

[U][B]Store[/B][/U]
[LIST]
[*] There is a new one time purchasable Dragonite Megapack on the store - this is a great deal for gem boxes and then we threw in 100 Diamond Dragonite straight up on top of that just because.
[*] There is now an option to purchase 33 Greater Dragon Caches at once with a bonus Diamond Dragonite Pouch.
[*]The Spooky Swag Bag has arrived to set the tone for Halloween! This collection of one Drak-O-Lantern Dragon Egg (which hatches into the very scary [B]Drak-O-Lantern[/B] dragon mount), five other great mounts (including Alduir, Autumn's Retreat from [B]Fizzinc [/B]), and four community created costumes:
[*] [B]Screamheart's [/B]Trovian Defender
[*] [B]Zoe's[/B] Mermaid
[*] [B]LippyLapras's [/B]Treasure Trovian
[*] [B]FriedSushi's[/B] S'more Sweetness
[/LIST]

[U][B]Community Created Content[/B][/U]
[LIST]
[*] New Jurassic Jungle Dungeon from [B]Evilagician[/B]! 
[*] New Shadow's Eve Jurassic Jungle Lair from [B]stedms[/B]! 
[*] New Jurassic Jungle Dungeon from [B]Screamheart[/B]! 
[*] New Candoria Dungeon from [B]Aveon0[/B]! 
[*] New Jurassic Jungle Dungeon from [B]Dark_Style_NL[/B]! 
[*] Coming to Chaos Chests near you: [B]HotShotChicago's [/B]Slightly Singed Skitterer, [B]HotShotChicago's [/B]Accursed Arachnid, and [B]Ainogommon's [/B]Neverending Necrowmancer
[/LIST]

[U][B]Additional Updates[/B][/U]
[LIST]
[*] The clocktower in the City of Bones shadow dungeon has been updated to make travel and NPC spawning less of a pain. 
[*] Challenges and Objectives now show the name of the reward being earned.
[*] Rally Blade is now more likely to match you with adventuring players (and ignoring AFK ones)
[*] The charge up attack used by the tribal humanoids in the Jurassic Jungle should now hit for much less. 
[*] Pegasus Wings are now less transparent. 
[*] The welcome screen no longer displays your chaos factor. Check your character stats if you need to know!
[*] Starter classes are now limited to only the 8 most accessible classes. Class coins and other methods of acquiring classes work as normal.

[/LIST]

[U][B]Bug Fixes[/B][/U]
[LIST]
[*] Kicking from club worlds should work correctly again, again.
[*] A relatively common crash involving using the mining laser has been fixed.
[*] Fix Mac client being unable to play intro movies with multithreading enabled.
[*] '/zonerestrict' should now work correctly
[*] Stellar Aura VFX now disappear when you die instead of floating around your tombstone. 
[*] Fixed projectile targeting in PVP 
[*] Iguana, and Sarcosuchus NPCs should now drop the correct trophies 
[*] Fixed bug where shift+mousewheel didn't rotate blocks while in build mode 
[/LIST]

notes.title: ONLINE - Patch - The Mighty Jungle - 7AM PDT (2PM GMT) September 13, 2016
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/tocZST1.gif[/IMG]

[B]Update 2[/B] - We're unlocking the servers now, so the extra time wasn't needed. Thanks everyone!

[B]Update 1[/B] - Hey all, our QA team is running through the final tests now. We don't expect to go over the 2 hour downtime, but just in case, I wanted to let you know we may go over by up to 15 minutes.

Hey folks,

We're coming offline on Tuesday to release the Mighty Jungle patch.

Downtime will start at [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7:00+AM+PDT+September+13+2016]7AM PDT (2PM GMT)[/URL] and should last approximately 2 hours. 

Thanks!

[U][B]Jurassic Jungle[/B][/U]
[LIST]
[*]The Jurassic Jungle biome is now live! It has new decoration recipes, styles, and enemies! It will start showing up randomly in Prime adventure worlds. Have fun! Includes a Dino Egg Temple lair from stedms!
[*]The Dino Tamer is now available for purchase outside of the Prehistoric Pack and is now unlockable with a Class Coin!
[/LIST]

[U][B]Weekly Updates[/B][/U]
[LIST]
[*]The rare contents of the Chaos Chest have been shuffled, get ahold of the Skulking Skitterling mount!
[*]Do do you you like like ore ore?? Get twice as much of it this week when mining!
[/LIST]

[U][B]Multi-threading Beta[/B][/U]
[LIST]
[*]Players can now enable multi-threading support. In your Trove.cfg (%appdata%/trove will get you there in windows), under the [User] section add the line "Multithreaded = true".
[*][URL=http://forums.trovegame.com/showthread.php?108701]Please give us feedback and report any bugs you may find[/URL]!
[/LIST]

[U][B]Additional Updates[/B][/U]
[LIST]
[*]Class Coins unlocked via the Refer A Friend program can no longer be loot collected - [b]Note added 9/13[/b]
[*]Dino Tamer: Pets are beefier.
[*]Dino Tamer: Clever Snare can now crit.
[*]Dino Tamer: when in the Battle Arena, the ultimate no longer increases run speed.
[*]Removed the increased damage debuff applied to targets under the effect of Clever Snare.
[*]Damage coefficient for the Clever Snare has been reduced.
[*]Increased the # of items on the Marketplace drop downs.
[*]Updated a lot of the UI to better accommodate longer, localized strings.
[*]Signs have been updated and no longer parse HTML.
[*]The Loot Collector no longer accepts additional loot once the "Components Collected" section is full.
[*]All categories in the Settings menu now prompt you to save unsaved changes when switching to new categories.
[*]Dragging from personal chests to the Marketplace interface is now supported.
[*]Shadow towers will now be spawned in their owner's region (EU or NA).
[*]Additional logging to help track down rubberbanding issues.
[/LIST]

[U][B]Bug Fixes[/B][/U]
[LIST]
[*]Updated the Dragon Coin description to refer to the correct Store Tab.
[*]Fixed a bug where zoning while mounted could crash you.
[*]Fixed a bug where escape wouldn't close the Clubs window.
[*]Fixed bug where Pirate Captain turret disappeared (but continued to fire) after 10 seconds even if you picked up doubloons.
[*]Fixed marketplace bug where no results appeared when Item Type was set to Blocks, Building, Crafting, Decoration, or Items.
[*]Fixed a disconnect issue related to trading.
[*]Fixed a disconnect issue related to NPCs destroying plants grown from seeds.
[*]Fixed a bug where the initial rotation of projectiles was slightly inaccurate.
[*]Fixed a bug where the Navigation Menu disallowed clicks that happened outside of it.
[*]Fixed an issue where sometimes icons wouldn't show up in the Trade window.
[*]Fixed an issue where particle collisions could create a feedback loop and travel relativistic speeds.
[/LIST]

notes.title: Patch - Daily Loot Edition - 7AM PDT (2PM GMT) August 16, 2016
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/tocZST1.gif[/IMG]

Hey folks,

We're coming offline on Tuesday to roll out the Daily Loot patch.

Downtime will start at [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7:00+AM+PDT+August+16+2016]7AM PDT (2PM GMT)[/URL] and should last approximately 90 minutes.

Thanks!

[QUOTE=Producer's Note]This week has a few big game changes. 

The first one is that we're making a big change to how Gems are unsocketed by effectively making them cost Cubits instead of Flux. The reason for this change is that Gems were intended to feel more 'permanently' socketed for both Contests and powering up multiple classes for use.

We intend to support this change through a few other changes also showing up this week. First of all daily loot chests are being added. These chests are earned once a day just by logging in and have many Gem-related rewards, including boosters up through the coveted Ninth Life. We intend for these boxes to be another way to ensure steady progress powering up Gems, especially as players seek to power up multiple classes.

In addition the class Contests for the first few tiers no longer require a competition between players and have been changed to required 2500PR and 5000PR respectively. This is going to open them up to many more winners each week. Since we see the new daily chests as a way to acquire daily and weekly Gem boosters we've changed the second tier reward from the Ninth Life to 2 Empowered Gem boxes. These time-gated boxes are now more available for players who are able to power up multiple classes and means additional progress towards high quality Empowered Gems.[/QUOTE]

[U][B]Weekly Updates:[/B][/U]
[LIST]
[*]Chaos Chest top loot is the Legendary Tome: Chaos Codex!
[*]Heart-a-phone & rename tags are now 66% off!
[*]Mounts remain 50% off the Credit price this week!
[/LIST]

[B][U]New in the Store:[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*]Two new low price Gem and Dragon Boost Packs are now available! 
[/LIST]

[B][U]Game Changes:[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*]Daily log in chests are now live! Earn one for logging in every day. This contain useful items like gem boosters, dust, and style unlockers. You might also win a big prize like extra inventory space or an incredibly rare and epic prize like 1500 chaos chests!
[*]Class contests now give their first two rewards based on power rank and are no longer a competition. The second level now gives 2 empowered gem boxes instead of a ninth life.
[*]There is now a new weekly contest for total xp earned and grants additional daily loot chests!
[*]Unsocketing Gems now costs Re-Gemerators. 1 per normal Gem and 2 per empowered. 
[/LIST]

[B][U]Bug Fixes:[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*]To prevent confusion, Legendary Tome: Tentacle Tract has been renamed to Legendary Tome: Ropey Readings.
[*](Mac) Fix random crashes on Mac that occur when loading particle effect files. 

[/LIST]
[U][B]Community Created Content:[/B][/U]
[LIST]
[*]New staff styles by MrWhiteee, Diefco, Jusiv, Cytorax, Toxidious, StoneWallJackson, Gaeden, KsykenV1, Gemric, Jorrit, Cosmodictator, Qoaleth, LordKyky, Narku, Martinez67, Iszalix, Deimondou, F4Bi, Jimbolul, PolacekX3, Rosemourne, Cozrator, 5p3x, ClovisAlfonso, DcaveDerps, xXTerminatorXx, and Grisildor have been added to the game! 
[*]New decor pieces by Player214, Xmarksit, MonsterAnt, Karrut, Ocgineer, Narwiff, mikeasfr, Knightlock, SkyRider3217, SkyTheVirus, Woofbottoms, jokerr77, and Rajeeb have been added to the game!
[/LIST]

The first one is that we're making a big change to how Gems are unsocketed by effectively making them cost Cubits instead of Flux. The reason for this change is that Gems were intended to feel more 'permanently' socketed for both Contests and powering up multiple classes for use.

We intend to support this change through a few other changes also showing up this week. First of all daily loot chests are being added. These chests are earned once a day just by logging in and have many Gem-related rewards, including boosters up through the coveted Ninth Life. We intend for these boxes to be another way to ensure steady progress powering up Gems, especially as players seek to power up multiple classes.

In addition the class Contests for the first few tiers no longer require a competition between players and have been changed to required 2500PR and 5000PR respectively. This is going to open them up to many more winners each week. Since we see the new daily chests as a way to acquire daily and weekly Gem boosters we've changed the second tier reward from the Ninth Life to 2 Empowered Gem boxes. These time-gated boxes are now more available for players who are able to power up multiple classes and means additional progress towards high quality Empowered Gems.[/QUOTE]

[*]Heart-a-phone & rename tags are now 66% off!
[*]Mounts remain 50% off the Credit price this week!
[/LIST]

[B][U]New in the Store:[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*]Two new low price Gem and Dragon Boost Packs are now available! 
[/LIST]

[B][U]Game Changes:[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*]Daily log in chests are now live! Earn one for logging in every day. This contain useful items like gem boosters, dust, and style unlockers. You might also win a big prize like extra inventory space or an incredibly rare and epic prize like 1500 chaos chests!
[*]Class contests now give their first two rewards based on power rank and are no longer a competition. The second level now gives 2 empowered gem boxes instead of a ninth life.
[*]There is now a new weekly contest for total xp earned and grants additional daily loot chests!
[*]Unsocketing Gems now costs Re-Gemerators. 1 per normal Gem and 2 per empowered. 
[/LIST]

[LIST]
[*]To prevent confusion, Legendary Tome: Tentacle Tract has been renamed to Legendary Tome: Ropey Readings.
[*](Mac) Fix random crashes on Mac that occur when loading particle effect files. 

[/LIST]

notes.title: It's the Trove anniversary celebration!
notes.content:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/07/anniversary_blog.jpg[/IMG]

We’re celebrating our first anniversary and this party is going to be wild! Take a look back on the year with our Trove infographic and see what we have planned for the next two weeks.

[B]
Trove’s Two Week Block Party Bash[/B]
[LIST]
[*]To start things off right, every Daily Bonus is active EVERY DAY for two weeks! Do the caps convey how serious this is? Good. Get all the bonuses!
[*]Save 66% off all Classes. This is the best time to pick up any Classes you’ve been looking to unlock. If you want to try before you buy, don’t forget about our free class trials.
[*]You’ll also receive a Minor Experience Coin for logging in and this will allow you to take one of your new classes from level 1 to level 10! If you’re already above level 10 it’ll still add that same amount of XP to your existing character.
[*]Get [URL=http://forums.trovegame.com/showthread.php?104057]daily login bonuses[/URL] and a special bonus every other day if you’re at Mastery Rank 20 or higher.
[*]Plus, Gem Packs are 25% off!
[/LIST]

Well, that must be everything. Slick infographic, Trove coming to consoles, and huge in game sales and bonuses. There’s no way this birthday celebration can get any better…hang on, Trovians…I’ve just received an update from the control room. THERE’S MORE!

[B]Introducing the Golden Ticket lootbox[/B]
[LIST]
[*]No chocolate bars needed here: receive [B]two[/B] Golden Ticket lockboxes every day that you sign in during our two week anniversary celebration.
[*]Golden Ticket Lootboxes have a chance of giving: Style Surprise boxes (unlocks a style you don’t already have), Omni Mount Unlockers (to grant a random mount you haven’t unlocked yet), Gem Boosters, Dragon Coins (used to unlock our legendary dragons), Dragon Souls, and that’s just the beginning.
[*]Maybe you’re a glutton for mounts. Luckily, you’ll also have a chance at receiving a special anniversary present: It’s Raining Mounts. Unlock a huge collection of mounts all at once!
[*]Another rare drop is the Dragon Force unlocker. This amazing marvel of modern technology unlocks Panatea, the Partifier; Ludini, Patron of Playfulness; Erimatra, Scourge of the Everdark; Selene, the Celestial Storm; Yorinn, the Dusk Shadow; and Erel, the Ironbolt!
[*]Patron status gives a plethora of perks and your Golden Ticket lootboxes have a chance to grant a full year of Patron status! One. Full. Year.
[/LIST]

Finally, we’re shining a spotlight on the real MVP: our community. Over the next two weeks we’re going to show off some of our great player artists, Club leaders, and the wonders built by players just like you!

One birthday down but we’re just getting started! Let's take a look back at Trove's first year!

[img]http://webcdn.triongames.com/trove/img/blog/TROVE_infographic_100dpi_Final.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Introducing the Trion Worlds Creator Program!
notes.content:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/06/CreatorProgram.jpg[/IMG]

We are both excited and humbled when we see the spectacular things players create for our games. To show our appreciation for all you do, we’re proud to introduce the [URL=http://www.trionworlds.com/en/creators/]Trion Worlds Creator Program[/URL]!

Whether you’re a shoutcaster, livestreamer, YouTuber, musician, or artist we want to support your creative spark. We’re looking for folks who consistently produce content featuring any or all of our games. Regardless if it’s your first time contacting us or we’ve been in touch before, everyone is welcome to apply!

Creators who are accepted into the program will be eligible for the following (and more):
[LIST]
[*]Early Access to New Content and Games
[*]Special Creator Program Loot
[*]Giveaway Codes (like the Streamer Dream boxes for Trove)
[*]Promotion on Official Social Media Channels
[*]Trion Worlds Event Invitations
[/LIST]
Apply for the [URL=http://www.trionworlds.com/en/creators/]Trion Worlds Creator Program[/URL] today and share your passion with the world!

notes.title: Update 5: Slow login, world changing, and delayed rewards - 7/12/2016
notes.content:
[B]Update 5:[/B] The servers have remained stable for a while now so we're going to start up the Leaderboards soon. We'll start granting the login awards as soon as possible, but please be patient as we want to make sure the game is good to go before putting too many tasks in place all at once.

[B]Update 4:[/B] Hey all, we're bringing the servers online but have implemented a queue so we can monitor server status as more players come online. As I mentioned in a previous update you likely will not receive your login bonus items right away but we'll let everyone know when they can start expecting those.

[B]Update 3:[/B] We're doing some additional checks but are much closer to the point where we'll open the Trove servers again. The Leaderboards will likely need some additional time to load up so please allow them an hour or two to be fully online.

In an effort to reduce the number of tasks being handled by our backend systems we're temporarily disabling the automated grant of login items. I'll post another update once we've enabled these items again. No one who should receive them will be left out and we'll get them enabled again as soon as possible.

Expect another update in 1 hour, unless we're online prior to that. (Currently 12:30 PM PDT)

[B]Update 2:[/B] The updates made by the dev team to address the current issues are being uploaded now and we'll test them out over the next few minutes. The items being granted to players for logging in will likely still take a while to arrive even if we come back online shortly, so please be patient. Another update in one hour if we're not back online. (Currently 11:30 AM PDT)

[B]Update 1:[/B] Sorry for the delayed post. We've taken Trove offline to address the issue with one of our backend systems. We're working to smooth things out now.  The dev team is working on a couple adjustments that should help alleviate the strain and I'll post our next update in one hour. (Currently 10:30AM PDT)

Hey everyone,

There are a whole bunch of  you logging in right now and we love you for it! That said, there are a some delays in getting signed in and changing worlds but we're working to address this as we speak.

With the number of claims happening all at once there may also be some delays there as well.

The Trovian Tumbler mount is auto-consumed when signing in, so it won't show up in the Claims window. Instead it should be one of your available mounts. However, with the delays it may take a while for it to unlock.

Please hang in there! I'll update this post in one hour with any news. (Currently 9:30 AM PDT)

Thanks everyone!

notes.title: Trove Anniversary Edition - 7AM PDT (2PM GMT) - July 12, 2016
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/tocZST1.gif[/IMG]

Hey folks, 

We're going to come offline on Tuesday to roll out the Trove Anniversary Edition patch.

Downtime will begin at [URL=https://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7:00AM+PDT+July+12+2016]7:00 AM PDT (2:00 PM GMT)[/URL] and is expected to take about 2 hours.

If we come back online early, or need any additional time, I'll update this thread.

Thanks all!

[U][B]Anniversary![/B][/U]
It's been about one year since we officially went live! To thank you for your ongoing support, we've set up a number of amazing bonuses for the next [U][B]two weeks[/B][/U]!
[LIST]
[*]All classes are 66% off
[*]Gem Packs are 25% off
[*]If you log in between July 12 and July 25th, you will get a Trovian Tumbler mount (created by Screamheart)
[*]If you log in between July 12 and July 25th, you will get a Minor Experience Coin! Using this coin will grant you enough experience to take a class from level 1 to 10!
[*]All Daily bonuses are active every day!
[*]A special log in bonus every day, with an additional bonus every other day for players with Mastery Rank 20 or higher!
[/LIST]

[U][B]Golden Ticket Lootboxes![/B][/U]
Available through contests, login bonuses, and attached to some products, these chests rarely contain some AMAZING prizes!
[LIST]
[*][B]It's Raining Mounts[/B] - Use this item to unlock a HUGE number of mounts, including all mounts in the following categories: Adventure Box, Rare, Store, Extra Life, Crafted, Fishing, Shadow Tower, Treasure Isles, Corgi, Cat, Shmeep, Centaur, Fancy, and Seasonal.
[*][B]Dragon Force[/B] - Use this item to unlock [B]SIX dragons[/B]: Panatea, Ludini, Erimatra, Selene, Yorin, and Erel!
[*][B]1 Year Patron Pass[/B] - Use this item to grant your account patron status for a whole year!
[/LIST]

[U][B]Anniversary Login Bonuses[/B][/U]
[LIST]
[*]Log in any time during the Anniversary party (July 12 07:00 - July 26 07:00 PT) to receive the Trovian Tumbler mount (designed by Screamheart!) as well as a Minor Experience Coin, which grants enough experience to take a class from level 1 to 10!
[*]Each day during the Anniversary party, log in to receive two Golden Ticket Lootboxes!
[/LIST]

[U][B]Daily Bonuses[/B][/U]
[LIST]
[*]July 12 07:00 - July 13 07:00 PT - 2 Days of Patron Pass! (Requires Mastery Level 20+)
[*]July 13 07:00 - July 14 07:00 PT - 1 Streamer Dream!
[*]July 14 07:00 - July 15 07:00 PT - 2 Days of Patron Pass! (Requires Mastery Level 20+)
[*]July 15 07:00 - July 16 07:00 PT - 5 Booster boxes!
[*]July 16 07:00 - July 17 07:00 PT - 2 Days of Patron Pass! (Requires Mastery Level 20+)
[*]July 17 07:00 - July 18 07:00 PT - 10 Dragon Coins!
[*]July 18 07:00 - July 19 07:00 PT - 2 Days of Patron Pass! (Requires Mastery Level 20+)
[*]July 19 07:00 - July 20 07:00 PT - 1 Empowered box!
[*]July 20 07:00 - July 21 07:00 PT - 2 Days of Patron Pass! (Requires Mastery Level 20+)

notes.title: ONLINE - Wednesday Patch - Revenge of Squeakers Edition - 7AM PDT (2PM GMT) - July 6, 2016
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/tocZST1.gif[/IMG]

Hey folks, 

We're going to come offline on Wednesday (we didn't do a Tuesday patch due to the 4th of July holiday) to roll out the Revenge of the Squeakers Edition patch.

Downtime will begin at [URL=https://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7:00AM+PDT+July+6+2016]7:00 AM PDT (2:00 PM GMT)[/URL] and is expected to take about 3 hours (due to the patch itself and additional system updates). 

If we come back online early, or need any additional time, I'll update this thread.

Thanks all!

[B][U]Weekly Events[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*]Chaos chest has been shuffled! This week's hotness is [B]Squeakers, the flying sugar glider![/B]
[*]Running out of space? We got you! [B]Extra rows of Inventory Space and extra tabs in the Personal Chest are both on sale for 50% off this week![/B]
[/LIST]

[B][U]Featured Changes[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*]Shadow Tower Normal has been tuned to be more focused on solo players. As a result, each Normal floor besides the last now only gives 1 Titan Soul. 
[*]Shaper's Vision boxes are now named Titan's Treasure and at Uncommon and Rare will give increasing amounts of flux instead of quad or penta souls.
[*]The Gems UI now has "Karma" bar display that will fill up on failed upgrade attempts. Gem Karma has already been live for a few weeks. As a reminder: If you have bad luck repeatedly, eventually you will be guaranteed a success! The amount of progress varies based on what booster item, if any, is used and the success rate at that particular level. The bar is reset to 0 on any successful upgrade (through random chance or through karma).
[*]Collections now has options to hide collected, hide uncollected, or show all collectables.
[*]Claims earned from leaderboard contests now show your final rank and score.
[*][B]Fixed a world-creation error that was causing players to get placed on servers in the wrong region, and would create very long world startup times on Mondays.[/B]
[/LIST]

[B][U]Misc Fixes / Updates[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed some stability and performance problems related to file loading.
[*]Fixed a bug where the comma key could not be used as a keybinding.
[*]In Collections, Dragon Ascension Badges now show how many Mastery Points are granted by the reward items at each level.
[*]In Collections, the Marketplace button now shows up for items you've already collected.
[*]Fixed a bug where pulling out of a trade session can prevent the other person from starting a new trade session.
[*]Neophyte's Wings now correctly state the Mastery unlock requirement (5).
[*]The tooltip that appears when mousing over a Gem Socket now has significantly fewer creative spellings of words.
[/LIST]

[B][U]Community Submissions[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*]New Candoria dungeon from WinRAR-exe!
[*]New Fae dungeon from ShiranaiYou!
[/LIST]

Added some remaining [U][B]Conqueror Level Alpha Supporters[/B][/U] to the in-game supporter list. Shout out to the following players:
[LIST]
[*]Chronozilla
[*]Quibble
[*]Tatijana
[*]Uniquisher
[*]Blasteron
[*]Sasha
[*]Vesago
[*]Teeheetummytums
[*]Beefaroo
[*]XPnow
[*]Kwongger
[/LIST]

Thanks all!

[B][U]Weekly Events[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*]Chaos Chest contents have been shuffled! Take a ride on the Crazy Busy Caterpillar!
[*]Costume Sale! Select costumes are 50% off this week only!
[/LIST]

[U][B]Gem Adjustments[/B][/U]
[LIST]
[*]You can now combine 10 Clover Gem Boosters in to 1 Horseshoe Gem Booster at the Adventurer's Crafting Bench. Empowered gems now Loot Collect in to Empowered Gem Fragments. Collect 10 of these and you can craft a Stellar Gem Box at the Adventurer's Crafting Bench.
[*]Lesser gems now have a higher chance to have more stats. 
[*]There is a new tradable Golden Gem Key which can be used on lesser gem boxes to get a guaranteed rare result. 
[*]There is a new 33 Booster Box in the Trove Store that also contains one bonus Golden Gem Key.
[*]Lowered the levels at which Gem sockets unlock! Empowered gems now become available earlier, at level 12, 15, and 20 (previously they were 21, 23, 25). Certain lesser gem sockets also unlock earlier, at level 23 and 26 (formerly 27,29). Slot those empowered gems, and benefit from the additional Power Rank earlier.
[*]Dust no longer drops from gem boxes when you get a rare result. Gems only!
[/LIST]

[U][B]Misc Updates/Changes/Fixes[/B][/U]
[LIST]
[*]Horizontal aircurrent blocks now show a directional indicator when placing them in build mode.
[*]Removed Energy Regen as a stat given to Pirate Captain when leveling up. It has been replaced with Health Regen.
[*]Fixed a bug where pulling out of a trade session can prevent the other person from starting a new trade session.
[*]Fixed Lil PuP's head to be more symmetrical.
[*]Remove extraneous purple torches in the hub's Adventure Tower
[*]Exposed additional strings to localization.
[*]The tooltip on the Empowered Gem Box now correctly states that Class Gem Key Fragments can be granted by opening the Box.
[*]Dr. Qubesly now gives out +30 more Mastery Points! Nothing a quick medical recertification wouldn't cure.
[/LIST]

[U][B]Community Submissions[/B][/U]
[LIST]
[*]New Candoria dungeon from Karokendo
[*]New Lost Isles dungeon from 1nsaint

[B][U]Weekly Events[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*]Chaos Chest contents have been shuffled! Take a ride on the Crazy Busy Caterpillar!
[*]Costume Sale! Select costumes are 50% off this week only!
[/LIST]

[U][B]Gem Adjustments[/B][/U]
[LIST]
[*]You can now combine 10 Clover Gem Boosters in to 1 Horseshoe Gem Booster at the Adventurer's Crafting Bench. Empowered gems now Loot Collect in to Empowered Gem Fragments. Collect 10 of these and you can craft a Stellar Gem Box at the Adventurer's Crafting Bench.
[*]Lesser gems now have a higher chance to have more stats. 
[*]There is a new tradable Golden Gem Key which can be used on lesser gem boxes to get a guaranteed rare result.

[*]Remove extraneous purple torches in the hub's Adventure Tower
[*]Exposed additional strings to localization.

[/LIST]

[U][B]Community Submissions[/B][/U]
[LIST]
[*]New Candoria dungeon from Karokendo
[*]New Lost Isles dungeon from 1nsaint
[*]New Tundra dungeon from Pennry
[/LIST]

notes.title: Get Double Gem Box Karma and So Much More!
notes.content:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/06/Patron.jpg[/IMG]

Become [URL=http://store.steampowered.com/app/304050]a Trove Patron[/URL] and open up a plentiful pack of perks like you’ve never seen before! Patron status just levelled up and all that power is yours to command.

New additions to the already powerful Patron perks include
[LIST]
[*]Double karma on all lesser gem and booster boxes so you can get a guaranteed powerful gem more quickly!
[*]Shadow Tower Key Fragments, Moon Key Fragments, and Eclipse Key Fragments all drop at twice the rate as before allowing you to quickly craft keys and get access to that sweet Shadow Tower loot.
[*]The Magic Find bonus is now doubled as well instead of the previous flat +200. Magic Find naturally increases as you kill enemies and increases the quality of loot dropped by enemies.
[/LIST]

[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/06/PatronPage.png[/IMG]

In addition to these huge new bonuses, Patron also comes with:
[LIST]
[*][B]+5 Jump[/B] which is great for new and veteran players, allowing you to reach new heights. In most games double jump is adorable but in Trove that is just the beginning!
[*][B]2x Daily Rewards [/B]means that every daily bonus we offer is twice as good. Collect twice as much ore on Tuesdays. Get even more adventure XP on Saturdays. On Wednesdays you’ll receive even more Gem boxes from dungeons!
[*][B]+2 Max Flask Capacity[/B] allows you to spend more time taking down the forces of shadow before you need to return to your Cornerstone or Club World to restock your flask charges.
[*][B]+4 Chaos Factor[/B] gives you a guaranteed four Chaos Chests every day that you login. These chests have a chance of containing some of the coolest loot in all of Trove. The more the merrier!
[*][B]+100% Battle Factor[/B] is a must have perk for the PvP masters out there. Get access to double the normal amount of weekly Battle Boxes from PvP matches.
[*][B]2x Battle Box Drop Rate[/B] means you’ll not only have access to twice as many Battle Boxes but they will drop twice as quickly.
[*][B]+50% Experience Gain[/B] works for just about everyone. New players will use the bonus XP to level up faster but the bonus XP also works on Tomes so Patrons will fill their Tomes up twice as fast each week!
[*][B]3x Daily Cubits[/B] for filling the Star Bar (this can be done by completing dungeons found in adventure worlds). Cubits can be used to purchase powerful items from the Trove Store.
[*][B]+100% Crafting Speed[/B] so you can craft in a jiffy and get back out on your adventures!
[*][B]+50 Lasermancy[/B] empowers your mining laser so you break down blocks with incredible speed.
[/LIST]

Patron status is better than ever so don’t miss out on these bountiful boosts today!

notes.title: Online - Patch - Collections Edition - 7AM PDT (2PM GMT) - June 21, 2016
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/tocZST1.gif[/IMG]

Update: We're back online and ready to go. Thanks all!

Hey folks, 

We're going to come offline for approximately 1 hour on Tuesday to roll out the Collections Edition patch.

Downtime will begin at [URL=https://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7:00AM+PDT+June+21+2016]7:00 AM PDT (2:00 PM GMT)[/URL]. If we come back online early, or need any additional time, I'll update this thread.

Thanks all!

[B]Producer's Note[/B]
[QUOTE]This week is our second week of changes focused around the new player experience. In addition, we have a very exciting revamp of the Collections Window and a new set of Dragons created by our community! We're going to be releasing these dragons in batches - this one is focused around rare tradable eggs. Future Dragon batches will have other types of acquisition. Finally, we've boosted Patron to be more appealing for end game players, many of whom used Patron early in their Trove experience but later decided it was no longer worthwhile.

Join us next week for some gem acquisition buffs and further new player experience enhancements.[/QUOTE]

[U][B]New Collections Window![/B][/U]
The collections screen got a major overhaul to improve loading time and functionality! The new window has some amazing features:
[LIST]
[*]Ability to favorite styles!
[*]Meta category showing all styles you've recently unlocked!
[*]Meta category showing all styles you've recently equipped!
[*]Search bar!
[*]A "find on the marketplace" button for uncollected styles.
[*]The ability to hide styles you don't own.
[*]And more!
[/LIST]

[U][B]Dragons[/B][/U]
Three new community designed dragons descend upon Trove! You can obtain the Ludini egg from the Adventure Boxes, Erimatra egg from the Shadow Boxes and the Panatea egg from piñatas!
[LIST]
[*]Ludini design by NovusNX
[*]Erimatra design by Screamheart
[*]Panatea design by Aviarei
[/LIST]

[U][B]Patron Update[/B][/U]
In addition to their previous benefits, Patrons now also get:
[LIST]
[*]Doubled drop rate for Shadow Tower key fragments.
[*]Doubled amount of karma generation for Gem Boxes (specifically this includes all lesser gem boxes and gem booster boxes).
[*]Changed the magic find bonus from +200 flat Magic Find to instead doubling Magic Find (+100%).
[/LIST]

[U][B]Misc Changes / Updates[/B][/U]
[LIST]
[*]Smoothed the XP curve before level 10, reducing the total time required to reach level 10.
[*]Increased Power Rank gained per class level to 15 (up from 10).
[*]Increased stats gained per level from 2 to 20 for the following  classes: Knight, Candy Barbarian, Boomeranger and Revenant. This brings stats these classes get more in line with other classes.
[*]Slightly increased the amount of SpellDamage granted to the Dracolyte between levels 2 and 7.
[*]Exposed even more in-game text for localization.
[*]Wednesday is no longer Fast Fishing day and is now Gem Box day! Gem Boxes now drop more often from dungeons!
[*]Seasons are beginning to change, and the Summer Piñatas have arrived!
[*]Quick play Battle Arena (PvP) now requires mastery rank 5 (down from 10).
[*]In Adept, Elite, and Master worlds there is now a small chance to get a higher level piece of equipment. You probably won't be high enough level to use it yet, but hang on to it until you can!
[*]Added a confirmation prompt to /mf and /metaforge commands.
[*]Adjusted which slash commands can be used in /metaforge.
[*]Changed the display of Tomes so that rather than a flat XP value it shows a percent. This is because when Tomes changed to use dungeon completion rather than any xp given, you no longer saw how much experience your tome was granted. As a quick reminder, Tomes earn experience by completing Battle Arena maps or by clearing Dungeons. The amount you get for clearing a dungeon of a given type (3 star, 1 star, etc.) is flat, despite the difficulty of the world you're in.
[*]Fixed a bug where the "Complete a Challenge" step in the tutorial objectives wouldn't complete until you completed all tiers of a challenge. It now completes after only the first tier.
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented language settings from saving when you restarted your client.
[*]Fixed a bug where right clicking items from your inventory wouldn't put them in the Trade UI after having successfully traded once.
[*]Fixed a bug where using /floodfill on the base-ground in metaforge would crash you.
[*]Fixed a bug where the visual effect of damaged blocks would show up even when VFX was in front of them.
[/LIST]

notes.title: Online - Patch - Class Trial Edition - June 14, 2016
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/tocZST1.gif[/IMG]

Update 1: We're back!

Hey folks, 

We're going to come offline for approximately 1 hour on Tuesday to roll out the Class Trial Edition Patch.

Downtime will begin at [URL=https://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7:00AM+PDT+June+14+2016]7:00 AM PDT (2:00 PM GMT)[/URL]. If we come back online early, or need any additional time, I'll update this thread.

Thanks all!

[B]Producer's Note[/B]
[QUOTE]This week is the start of a round of changes designed to make the early and mid-game of Trove a smoother experience. We've spent some time recently tracking and watching new player data, and that combined with community feedback is driving a series of changes that you will see roll out over the coming weeks.[/QUOTE]

[U][B]Class Trials[/B][/U]
[LIST]
[*]You now have the option to try out a class before you purchase it!
[*]Trial Classes can be played up to level 4 before you stop earning experience.
[*]Trial Classes do not get stat bonuses from Mastery Rank, nor from any unlocked Dragons.
[/LIST]

[U][B]Weekly[/B][/U]
[LIST]
[*]New Chaos Chest! Get an all-new Pop Dance Pad if you're lucky!
[*]Spring Piñatas are almost gone! Get them now for 50% off before summer arrives!
[*]Ships are also 50% off for this week!
[/LIST]

[U][B]Mastery Changes[/B][/U]
[LIST]
[*]Reduced mastery points required for all ranks up to 5 to 25 points, 6-10 to 50 points, and 11-20 to 75 points.
[*]Players who have already bypassed these levels will see a bump in their Mastery Rank.
[/LIST]

[U][B]BETA for FR/DE Translations[/B][/U]
A [B][I]very BETA[/I][/B] version of our initial translations for FR/DE is now accessible from within the game.

notes.title: Patch - Claims & Karma Edition - 5/24/2016
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/tocZST1.gif[/IMG]

Hey folks, 

We're going to come offline for approximately 2 hours on Tuesday to roll out the Claims & Karma Edition patch.

Downtime will begin at [URL=https://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7:00AM+PDT+May+24+2016]7:00 AM PDT (2:00 PM GMT)[/URL]. If we come back online early, or need any additional time, I'll update this thread.

Thanks all!

[U][B]Weekly Updates[/B][/U]
[LIST]
[*]The chaos chest has been shuffled! Keep an eye out for the Chromatic Cumulus mount!
[*]Bonus loot! For a limited time Jade Covers can uncommonly be found in Chaos Chests!
[*]Sale! For this week only, all classes are 50% off!
[*]Limited Time Credit Pack Bonus! The 18500 credit pack also includes 100 tradable Bone Dragon souls! Enough to unlock the whole dragon!
[/LIST]

[B][U]The new Claims System is in place.[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*]This new feature is meant to help keep track of "passive" awards granted while playing Trove, and to help introduce players to the systems that grant them.
[*]When you earn rewards/items from a variety of gameplay systems they now go into your Claims window (In the Navigation Menu, but also reachable via hotkey, which is L by default).
[*]Some items may still go into your inventory or collections directly, while still leaving a breadcrumb in the Claims window.
[*]Once claimed, you can click the magnifying glass to "find" where your item went (Note: for some collection items, you may have to click twice to correctly scroll the window, this is a bug that will be fixed soon!)
[*]Some items have a time limit associated with them. For instance, items granted from Tomes will last 3 days (7 days for Legendary Tomes). One time rewards have no time limit.
[*]Once an item is claimed, it remains in the Claims window until you close and re-open Trove, so you can revisit the Claims list and use it to find a style you've unlocked.
[/LIST]


[U][B]Misc Changes/Fixes[/B][/U]
[LIST]
[*]Upgrading Gems now has a Karma system in place, so every upgrade attempt counts towards a guaranteed upgrade. Karma progress is stored on gems individually. Any level up will reset the counter, and progress is based on success chance (so boosters will increase the amount faster). This is designed to prevent streaks of bad luck when leveling gems and to ensure that all resources spent towards leveling up gems has some element of progress.
[*]Just in time for election season, added the ability to opt-out of chat for clubs you're a member of on the Clubs UI.
[*]Added some additional stats to /metrics.
[*]Updated Aquilia the Furred to correctly credit Qoaleth!
[*]Fixed some incorrect text on some Dragon allies.
[*]More improved latency logging to help track down lag fixes.
[*]Palashien can no longer destroy blocks at the Outpost of Light.
[*]Fixed a bug where some sounds stuck around longer than they should.
[*]Fixed a bug where you'd erroneously receive "you are now online" messages when toggling some settings.
[*]Added text to Empowered Gems to point out that you can only equip a single Empowered Gem of a given power at one time.
[/LIST]

Hey folks, 

We're going to come offline for about one hour on Tuesday to roll out our latest patch, the Flasky Tuesday Edition!

Downtime will begin at [URL=https://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7:00AM+PDT+May+17+2016]7:00 AM PDT (2:00 PM GMT)[/URL]. 

Thanks all!

[B][U]Weekly Events[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*]Chaos Chest contents have been shuffled! This week, get your hands on Shock (the Monkey)!
[*]Fast Fishing! For this week fish twice as fast!
[*]Flasks are on sale! All credit prices have been halved for this week only!
[/LIST]

[B][U]Misc Changes & Bug Fixes[/U][/B]
[LIST]
[*]Right clicking on a item's icon that is listed the Market Place sale will now cancel the listing.
[*]Additional logging to help improve latency down the line!
[*]Fixed a bug where interacting with a Loot Collector, then closing the loot collector, then right clicking an item in your inventory wouldn't try to equip that item.
[*]Fixed a bug where right clicking items in Chests with the Marketplace and Inventory both open would incorrectly try to put items from your inventory into the Marketplace sale slots.
[*]Fixed bug where store sometimes didn't immediately disable purchase buttons after buying products that cannot be repurchased.
[*]Fixed a bug where players could get stuck if they changed classes while dodging.
