[LIST]
[*]Now you can have multiple Cornerstones! Open the Cornerstones window from the F1 menu to manage your Cornerstone slots. 
[*]New Chaos Chest contents! Top loot this week are the Grim Throne mounts!
[*]Double Dragon Souls! The reward for completing a daily Challenge now gives two Winter Dragon Souls!
[*]New adventure boxes! Don't be left out, ride a lizard mount.
[/LIST]

[B]Game Updates[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Battle Trophies are live! These trophies (designed by Tribe) are rare drops from the Battle Arena that display the name of your vanquished foe, as well as the date of your glorious victory. Battle Trophies can be placed in Club Worlds and Cornerstones

notes.title: Update 3 - Server Stability Issues and Queues - 1/2/2016
notes.content:
[IMG]http://webcdn.triongames.com/patcher/glyph-all/hotfix_trove.jpg[/IMG]

[B]Update 3[/B] - All server nodes have been restarted, and the population cap has been increased to reduce the current queue. As more players join, some brief queues may happen, but we'll continue to increase population, as needed.

Our ongoing server issues are being worked on currently, which is why the PTS has been made unavailable. We're actively testing methods of moving our database to the new system, which will eliminate most of the issues we face. We still need some time, but the transition will be happening this month. Thanks again for your patience!

Update 2 - We've lowered our population cap a little bit while restarting one final node. We may see some short queues for the next half hour, or so. 

Update 1 - We're online and ready to play! The queue is gone for now, but we're still keeping an eye on the servers and will adjust as necessary to be sure we keep the gaming running smoothly.

Hey all,

Following our maintenance today, we implemented a low population cap as we monitored server health. Unfortunately, the servers were running into trouble, so we're offline again as the team works to resolve the issue.

Please bear with us, while we work to address these issues.

Thanks!

notes.content:
[IMG]http://webcdn.triongames.com/patcher/glyph-all/hotfix_trove.jpg[/IMG]

Hey folks!

We will be performing maintenance and rolling out the Flower Power patch on Tuesday.

I'll keep this post updated if we come back online early, or need a bit more time.

Thanks for your patience! 

[B]Features[/B]
[LIST]
[*][URL=http://steamcommunity.com/games/304050/announcements/detail/750211248410535236][B]The Chloromancer[/B][/URL] class is available in the Trove Store! 
[*]Mastery rewards now go up to 300! There are a lot of rewards in between, but at 250 you’ll receive a non-tradable [B]Chaos Coin[/B], and at 300 you’ll receive [B]Valkizer, the King of Dragons[/B]!
[*]Costumes listed in the Marketplace will now show their appearance
[*][B]Chaos Chests[/B] have been updated, and have a chance to drop the Super Magical Revenant
 costume created by [B]GadgetCat[/B]! Top loot this week is the [B]Festive Fae Sleigh[/B].
[*]Sworn to destroy the holiday spirit and good cheer ushered in by Snowfest, dastardly Ice Giants now invade the lands of Trove
[*]Ice Giant invaders drop [B]Winter Giant Chests[/B] that have a chance of unlocking the new penguin allies created by [B]GogestickCJ[/B]
[/LIST]
[B]Save 50% on all these costumes to keep your Trovian warm this winter![/B]
[LIST]
[*]Bone knight
[*]Uberman
[*]Bee Trickster, 
[*]Dreamolyte
[*]Heartbleed
[*]Dark Infineon
[*]Molten Fury
[*]Shadow's Shroud
[*]Ghost Pirate
[*]Magic Man
[*]Soulkeeper
[*]Twilight Temperance
[*]Candorian Praetorian
[/LIST]
[B]Game Updates[/B]
[LIST]
[*]The Ice Sage's ultimate no longer affects enemies who are dodging 
[*]Invulnerability following the use of dodge lasts 33% longer 
[*]Stuns in PvP last 70% of their PvE duration
[*]Characters who use spears will now attack directly in front of them while strafing
[*]Players who do not score a kill, capture the flag, or return their own team flag will receive no credit toward a Battle Box and will receive 50% Battle XP
[*]Use the following slash command in game to see your current time toward your next Battle Box: /getbattleboxinfo
[*]Omni Style Surprise can now unlock Radiant styles
[/LIST]
[B]New for builders![/B]
[LIST]
[*]Water Block – Place these blocks into an area then press E to convert all the blocks into water. This water will remain in the shape of the placed blocks, so it allows greater control of water, similar to the Last Airbender, who was very good with water (not the movie one, the TV show).
[*]Scaffolding Block – Place like any other block, and use it to stand on while building tall creations. When done, press E and these blocks will disappear.
[*]Club Intra-World Portals are here! Place these portals in Club Worlds to allow players to quickly teleport across great distances, or to specific locations, such as Shadow Tower or Battle Arena portals.
[/LIST]

[B]Bug Fixes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed a rendering bug that could cause pieces of some decorations to disappear
[*]Fixed bug where fishing lures passed through blocks
[*]Fix issue where joining other players is disabled after leaving a PvP world
[*]Reducing frequency of bug where Fae Trickster's basic attack hits but does no damage
[*]Fixed bug where sponges passed through blocks and weren't returned
[/LIST]

notes.content:
[IMG]http://webcdn.triongames.com/patcher/glyph-all/hotfix_trove.jpg[/IMG]

Hey folks!

We will be performing maintenance and rolling out the Flower Power patch on Tuesday.

The servers will come down at [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7+AM+PST+December+15+2015]7 AM PST / 3 PM GMT[/URL] and expected down time is 3 hours. 

I'll keep this post updated if we come back online early, or need a bit more time.

Thanks for your patience! 

[B]Features[/B]
[LIST]
[*][URL=http://steamcommunity.com/games/304050/announcements/detail/750211248410535236][B]The Chloromancer[/B][/URL] class is available in the Trove Store! 
[*]Mastery rewards now go up to 300! There are a lot of rewards in between, but at 250 you’ll receive a non-tradable [B]Chaos Coin[/B], and at 300 you’ll receive [B]Valkizer, the King of Dragons[/B]!
[*]Costumes listed in the Marketplace will now show their appearance
[*][B]Chaos Chests[/B] have been updated, and have a chance to drop the Super Magical Revenant
 costume created by [B]GadgetCat[/B]! Top loot this week is the [B]Festive Fae Sleigh[/B].
[*]Sworn to destroy the holiday spirit and good cheer ushered in by Snowfest, dastardly Ice Giants now invade the lands of Trove
[*]Ice Giant invaders drop [B]Winter Giant Chests[/B] that have a chance of unlocking the new penguin allies created by [B]GogestickCJ[/B]
[/LIST]
[B]Save 50% on all these costumes to keep your Trovian warm this winter![/B]
[LIST]
[*]Bone knight
[*]Uberman
[*]Bee Trickster, 
[*]Dreamolyte
[*]Heartbleed
[*]Dark Infineon
[*]Molten Fury
[*]Shadow's Shroud
[*]Ghost Pirate
[*]Magic Man
[*]Soulkeeper
[*]Twilight Temperance
[*]Candorian Praetorian

[*]Reducing frequency of bug where Fae Trickster's basic attack hits but does no damage

notes.title: Patch - Battleverse Edition - 7AM PST / 3 PM GMT - 12/8/2015
notes.content:
[IMG]http://webcdn.triongames.com/patcher/glyph-all/hotfix_trove.jpg[/IMG]

Hey folks!

We will be performing maintenance and rolling out the Battleverse patch on Tuesday.

The servers will come down at [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7+AM+PST+December+8+2015]7 AM PDT / 3 PM GMT[/URL] and expected down time is 4 hours. 

I'll keep this post updated if we come back online early, or need a bit more time.

Thanks for your patience!

[B]Features[/B]
[LIST]
[*]It’s double Chaos Factor week! Get two Chaos Chests for every Chaos Factor on your account
[*]New chaos chest loot! Top loot this week is 2x Polar Caterkiller
[*]3, 6, and 12 Month Patron passes are now available on the Trove Store! Not only are they for sale, but they’re also on sale! Get this discounted price while you can.
[/LIST]

[B]Game Updates[/B]

[LIST]
[*]The character sheet has been updated! Left click to equip styles rather than using a separate slot.
[*]The Adventure Tower in the Hub now has all Adventure Portals!
[*]Patron status now grants double Battle Factor and doubles your drop rate of Battle Boxes
[*]Chestnut Seeds have returned! Botanist-level gardeners can craft them at their Gardening Bench. 
[*]The Bull Dozer mount and Big Bomb legendary tome are available for sale on the Trove Store individually as well as in the Builder’s Pack
[*]Upgraded terraformer visuals. Now a glowing grid will show you the exact areas that will be destroyed and remade by your terraforming!
[*]Basic attack projectiles are now faster
[*]Big Bombs (designed by Tribe) are now craftable in game (these bombs take out a big chunk of the world, but not dungeons)
[*]Movement speed now 25% faster in the Battle Arena (PvP)
[/LIST]

[B]New Packs on the Trove Store! [/B]

[I]Collector’s Pack[/I] (One per account)
[LIST]
[*]12 Omni Mount Unlockers (unlock any Meownt, Pemblock, or Adventure Mount you don’t already have)
[*]100 Omni Style Unlockers (designed by Tribe) – Unlocks an equipment style you don’t already have
[*]Hat of hats – An extra tall hat designed by Tribe
[*]2 Golden Chaos Chests
[/LIST]

[I]Creator’s Pack[/I] (One per account)
[LIST]
[*]Bull Dozer – A new steam powered bull mount that can destroy blocks in your Club World as you ride (designed by Screamheart)
[*]Big Bomb Legendary Tome – Get 40 big bombs, for free, once a week (great for destroying large collections of blocks)
[*]A ton of blocks and ore to get you building: 500 infinium, 1000 formicite, 5000 shapestone, 9999 of each primal block, 50 Omni decoration recipes (unlocks any decoration recipes you don’t already have unlocked).
[/LIST]

[I]Radiant Pack[/I] (One per account. Requires Mastery Rank 10.) 
[LIST]
[*]Includes all resources needed to take a Resplendent item up to Radiant quality
[*]9999 Flux
[*]999 Eyes of Qubthulu
[*]2 Twice Forged Shadow Soul
[*]2 Thrice Forged Shadow Soul
[*]2 Quad Forged Shadow Soul
[*]3 penta forged shadow Soul
[*]3 Purified Flame
[/LIST]

[I]Battle Pack[/I] (One per account. Requires Mastery Rank 10.)
[LIST]
[*]20 Battle Boxes
[*]Permanent +2 Battle Factor
[*]A War Tiger, War Wolf, and Terror Turtle variant (designed by FriedSushi)
[/LIST]

[B]Battle Arena Rewards[/B]
[LIST]
[*]The Trove Battle Arena now grants rewards!
[*]Compete in the arena to increase your Battle Level
[*]Increasing your Battle Level unlocks rewards, including auras, mounts, and Battle Factor
[*]Battle Factor determines the maximum number of Battle Boxes you can earn each week
[*]Battle Boxes drop randomly while playing, but you won't get credit towards the next one if you leave games before they end.
[*]Classic Battle Boxes will contain a Battle Banner that grants PvP stats when equipped in the brand new Banner slot on the Character sheet (C) 
[*]Your equipped Battle Banner will also modify the power ups received in Battle Arena matches
[*]Break down Battle Banners in the Loot Collector to receive Arena Coins, which can be spent at the Battle Broker vendors located next to the Battle Arena portal in the Hub
[/LIST]

[B]Custom Battle Arenas[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Build your own custom Battle Arenas in Club Worlds that receive the same rewards as the Battle Arenas in the Hub!
[*]Create custom spawn points, flag spawns, and capture points for both teams. In addition, you can place turrets, flags of strife and powerup spawn points throughout your map.
[*]Craft tag blocks and the Battle Arena portal for custom matches at the Worldspring
[*]Replaced turrets in cornerstones with PvP turret tagblocks. If you place these blocks in your custom PvP map, they will be transformed into active turrets when the game begins.
[*]You can start a custom arena match before 10 players have joined a match by using the command /testarena, but these matches will not grant rewards
[/LIST]

[B]Bug Fixes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed bug where Lunar Lancer could become unable to use abilities after mashing the M2 ability
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed the Lunar Lancer to carry a flag while grappling
[*]Fixed a bug where Boomeranger didn’t always get cooldown reduction after catching a boomerang
[/LIST]

notes.title: Online - Patch - Snowfest Edition - 7 AM PST / 3 PM GMT
notes.content:
[IMG]http://webcdn.triongames.com/patcher/glyph-all/hotfix_trove.jpg[/IMG]

Update 1: We're online a bit early today. Enjoy Snowfest!

We'll be bringing the Trove servers offline on Tuesday to roll out the Snowfest patch.

The servers will come down at [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7+AM+PST+December+1+2015]7AM PST / 3 PM GMT[/URL] and expected downtime is 4 hours.

I'll update this post if we come back online early, or need any additional time.

Thanks!

[B]Features[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Winter is coming, and the Winter Dragon brood has arrived!
[*]The Hub has been updated in honor of Snowfest
[*]The Winter Piñata returns to the Trove Store!
[*]It’s a Snowfest miracle: the Santa Barbarian costume has returned to the Trove Store!
[*]Two winter mounts are back in action: Rudolph Raptor and Reveling Reindeer!
[*]Fish at double speed all week!
[*]Chaos Chests have been updated. Top loot this week is the Metalhead Mag Rider!
[/LIST]
[B]Game Update[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Challenges now show up at Mastery Rank 10
[*]Sky Portal and Shadow Tower Portal are now significantly cheaper to craft
[*]Shadow Tower enemies on floor 1 and 2 have significantly reduced health
[*]There is now a new Golden Thread objective to enter the Shadow Tower
[*]Wings are now unlocked at Mastery Rank 5 while Qubesly unlocks at Mastery Rank 10
[*]Boots from fishing have been reduced by 75% (sorry boot lovers!)
[*]Shaper's Dream boxes are no longer available
[*]Shaper's Vision boxes now give more flux
[/LIST]
[B]Bug Fixes[/B]

notes.title: It’s Block Friday – I’m In Love!
notes.content:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2015/11/blog2.jpg[/IMG]

All this week we’re celebrating [B]Block Friday[/B], and it’s your chance to get the best deals of the year!

Our [B][URL=http://steamcommunity.com/games/304050/announcements/detail/750205285048503880]Autumn Piñatas[/URL][/B] are about to fall out of the [B]Trove Store[/B], so stuff your stockings while you still can. We've added Autumn styles and the piñata helm to the possible loot, and removed the Candy Corn. Not only that, but they are also half price until [B]December 1st![/B]

A stack of packs are returning to the Trove Store (buy them in game using your Steam Wallet) for this week only! [B]Save 50%[/B] on these cool collections before they disappear!
[LIST]
[*][B]The Power Pack[/B]- Get two class coins, flask tokens, wings, stuff for building, costume, a mount, a ship, and so much more!
[*][B]Block Beards Pirate Pack[/B] – Unlock the Pirate Captain class, two ships, a unique sail, and two costumes!
[*][B]Blitz and Glitz Costume Pack[/B] – Eight of the glitziest costumes in all of Trove, including the Shadow’s Disciple, Dark Infineon, and the Lunar Ronin!
[*][B]Adventure Pack [/B]– Take a walk on the wild side with the cunning Boomeranger class along with two flasks, two costumes, and five emblems!
[*][B]To the Nines Costume Pack[/B] – Pick up this costume pack to unlock nine costumes created by players just like you!
[*][B]Necrofancy Pack[/B] – Delve into the dark arts with the Tomb Raiser class, two unique costumes, the Boneweaver and Spite Biter spider mounts, and the magnificent Soulfire Wings!
[*][B]Lunacy Pack[/B] – You want to get nuts? Come on, let’s get nuts! Unleash the Lunar Lancer class, two costumes, two mounts, and two tomes that you can level up to unlock rewards every week!
[/LIST]
Winter is coming. Treat yourself to these hot deals before they vanish on December 1st!

notes.title: Update 7 - Patch - Block Friday Edition - 11/24/2015 - 7AM PST / 3 PM GMT
notes.content:
[IMG]http://webcdn.triongames.com/patcher/glyph-all/hotfix_trove.jpg[/IMG]


[B]Update 7:[/B] (6:20 PM PST / 2:20 AM GMT) We'll be unlocking the servers soon, but will have queues as we monitor our status. 

[B]Update 6:[/B] (5:20 PM PST / 1:20 AM GMT) Servers are restarting, and we'll be doing some testing. Expect another update in 1 hour, if we're still offline.

[B]Update 5:[/B] (3:30 PM PST / 11:30 PM GMT) To resolve the issues we've been experiencing since our previous crash, we're going to bring everything offline, and restart all services while we monitor performance. I'll post another update in 2 hours, if we haven't already come back online.

Update 4: (2:45 PM PST / 10:45 PM GMT) Unfortunately, we've had a server crash, but we're in the process of bringing the game back online. We're continuing to make adjustments to resolve the server stability issues so we can remove the queues, but please bear with us.

[B]Update 3: [/B](11:55 AM PST / 7:55 PM GMT) Trove is back online. We've set a fairly low population cap while we keep an eye on things, so there will be some queues.

[B]Update 2: [/B] (11:45 AM PST / 7:45 PM GMT) We've restarted our servers and are running additional checks before we get things unlocked. I'll post again in 60 minutes if we haven't yet come online already.

[b]Update 1: (10:20 AM PST / 6:20 PM GMT)[/b] After unlocking the game, we began to see unexpected errors pop up. We're bringing the game offline again to do some additional maintenance, and I'll update this thread with news in 90 minutes, if we're not back online.

Hey folks!

We will be performing maintenance and rolling out the Block Friday patch on Tuesday.

The servers will come down at [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7+AM+PST+November+24+2015]7 AM PDT / 3 PM GMT[/URL] and expected down time is 4.5 hours. 

I'll keep this post updated if we come back online early, or need a bit more time.

Thanks for your patience!

[B]Features[/B]
* Chaos Chests have been updated! Top loot this week are the Wings of Shadowy Descent!
* Block Friday Sale! Get 50% off the following from the Trove Store (yup, you can use your Steam Wallet!):[LIST]
[*]The Power Pack
[*]Block Beards Pirate 
[*]Blitz and Glitz Costume 
[*]Adventure Pack 
[*]To the Nines Costume Pack 
[*]Necrofancy Pack 
[*]Lunacy Pack
[/LIST]

[B]Autumn Piñata Update[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Save 50% on Autumn Piñatas 
[*]They are disappearing next week, so now is the last chance to stock up!
[*]These piñatas now drop Autumn Recipes and the helm style, but no longer drop Candy Corn
[/LIST]

[B]Game Updates[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Doubled projectile speed of radiant arrow on Shadow Hunter
[*]Thursday's bonus drops now only apply to Adventure Boxes and Event Box drops. Pemblocks and Meownts are now more rare. 
[*]Cursed Vale Terraformer has been added to the Worldspring
[*]Moved the output of /stats back to the chat window. 
[*]Improved the mining laser. Block desync while mining should now be exceedingly rare. 
[*]Slight change to timestamp format for Club logs.
[*]Loot pickup text moved back to right side of screen
[/LIST]

[B]Bug Fixes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed a bug where Shadow Tower Portals remained open forever on Cornerstones 
[*]Fixed some instances where other players didn't animate while using abilities 
[*]Tome rewards will now go into overflow inventory if your inventory is full 
[*]Fixed a bug where grass was sometimes not destroyed when shot by projectiles 
[*]Fixed a bug where Shadow Hunter's Radiant Arrow sometimes didn't damage enemies if it first went through a wall, or another enemy 
[*]Fixed general bug where enemies and terrain sometimes didn't get hit by projectiles if the projectile first pierced another object
[*]Fixed a broken ability combination. You know the one.
[*]Game Pads: Fix camera thumb stick sometimes not working immediately after changing thumb stick invert in Settings
[*]Fixed an issue that cause World chat to become broken if it was being used while changing worlds. 
[*]Club logs will now display item names correctly
[*]Fixed bug where blocks placed on the client would disappear after a couple of seconds. This can still happen due to a valid server correction, but it should be infrequent.
[/LIST]

notes.title: Now Live! - Battle Arena Beta Edition - 7:00 AM PST / 3:00 PM GMT - 11/17/2015
notes.content:
[img]http://webcdn.triongames.com/patcher/glyph-all/hotfix_trove.jpg[/img]

Greetings Trovians!

We will have 4 hours of downtime starting at [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7%3A00+AM+PST+November+17+2015]7:00 AM PST on November 17, 2015[/URL]. During this downtime, the team will perform maintenance and deploy the Battle Arena Beta patch!

We appreciate your patience, everyone!

[B]Features[/B]
[LIST]
[*]The Trove Battle Arena Beta is available! Find the flickering Battle Arena Portal in the new Hub building to join a match! Rewards are not yet available, but will be added later.
[*]Turkeytopia has arrived! Open Turkeytopia Mystery Boxes for a chance at seasonal rewards. Act fast, as Turkeytopia ends on December 1st!
[*]All players who have spent any money in Trove can now get Turkeytopia-themed wings for free! Just visit the Trove Store to unlock your wings.
[*]Dream Gobbler invaders are looking to knock your block off! Fend off the fighting fowl to earn a chance at an Appeased Dream Gobbler or Trotting Turkey mount!
[*]Chaos Chest has been updated! Shadowy Sarcophagus is the top loot this week!
[/LIST]
[B]Game Update[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Marketplace listings now expire after one week. Expired listings no longer appear for sale and must be canceled to reclaim the listed item. 
[*]Updated 'King's Tomb' Undead Hills dungeon by Curtharv. 
[*]Updated 'Pinball Machine' Neon City dungeon by Pix. 
[/LIST]
[B]Bug Fixes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed bug where the command /clearcornerstone didn't successfully clear a Cornerstone
[*]Fix truncation of payment methods in the Trove Store.
[*]Improved projectile client prediction; fixes bugs where projectiles such as bombs and the Boomeranger's boomerang appear to warp while travelling

notes.title: Release The Raving Revenant!
notes.content:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2015/11/blog1.jpg[/IMG]

Rise from the realm of spirits as Trove’s newest class: the [B]Revenant[/B]! This steel-plated specter sacrifices health to deal damage and defend allies. The Revenant is now live (so to speak), and we have all you need to know right here! 

[B]Vengeful Spirits (left-click)[/B]
Vengeful Spirits? More like, “vengeful spear-its” am I right? No? Well, let’s not get caught up in the minutia. Your basic attack (left mouse button) stabs at enemies with your spear, restoring a small amount of health to the Revenant. As you defeat foes, you steal their souls to empower your Spirit Wraith. When your health has been depleted, you will not go gentle into that good night. Instead, a powerful Spirit Wraith will burst forth, returning 50% of your health, and fighting by your side.

The cool down on the Spirit Wraith is indicated by smoke emanating from Revenant, and is reduced by defeating enemies. If the Spirit Wraith is on cool down, be sure to pop those health potions!

[B]Bulwark Bash (right-click)[/B]
A brutal shield slam that damages anyone unfortunate enough to be standing in front of the Revenant, taunting enemies and forcing them to attack you. Cooldown: 7 Seconds.

[B]Spirit Spears (1)[/B]
Summon ghostly spears to attack all enemies in front of the Revenant. The damage done is based on your maximum health. Reaching into the spirit world to use these deadly armaments requires a heavy price. The Revenant sacrifices health for as long as the Spirit Spears are cast.

[B]Spirit Storm (2)[/B]
A whirling vortex of spirit energy surrounds the Revenant, pulling enemies closer, and firing exploding blasts of spiritual energy. Upon exploding, these spirit blasts will heal friends while damaging foes. Cooldown: 20 Seconds.

The unrepentant Revenant requires penance from pusillanimous pariahs!

For those who can’t get enough of this tenacious tank, the [b]Raving Revenant Pack[/b] is also available in the Trove Store for purchase with the Steam Wallet! This brand new pack includes:
[LIST]
[*]The Revenant class
[*]The Metalhead Dance Pad mag rider
[*]Scion of Cygnus costume
[*]Candorian Praetorian costume
[*]A Golden Chaos Chest 
[*]The Revenant Warhorse mount!
[/LIST]
Bang your head (if you have one), shield bash your enemies, and look good doing it. The Raving Revenant Pack is your one way ticket to Awesome Town.

[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2015/10/extra-life-blog.jpg[/IMG]

A quick reminder that the Extra Life stream starts tomorrow, and we'll spend the whole day raising money for the kids!

If you donate via the [URL=http://www.extra-life.org/index.cfm?fuseaction=donorDrive.participant&participantID=176055]Extra Life page of game designer Kumar ‘Atronos’ Daryanani[/URL] you can also help design items that will be added to Trove! Check out his page for specifics. 

Join us on [url=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=November+7+9am+PDT+]November 7th at 9am PDT[/url] for a 24 hour stream, featuring [B]all Trion Worlds games[/B]! You can support us by [URL=http://www.extra-life.org/index.cfm?fuseaction=register.start&eventID=525&teamID=23293]signing up for the Trion Team[/URL]. Friends and family can sponsor your day of marathon gaming. 

[B]Extra Life 2015 Rewards[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Raise $15 in donations to get the [B]Dr. Qubesly ally[/B]!
[*]Raise $25 in donations and you’ll get the [B]Joystick ally[/B]!
[*]Raise $75  in donations to earn the [B]Arcade Helm[/B]!
[*]Raise $150 in donations and you’ll get a non-tradable [B]Chaos Coin[/B]!
[*]Everyone who raises an incredible $500 in donations will be entered into our Hero Drawing, and 25 Heroes (selected at random) will receive an amazing [B]25,000 Credits[/B]!
[/LIST]

Plus, we’ll be doing LIVE giveaways on the stream throughout the event. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/304050/announcements/detail/753585044665019549]Click here for our previous post[/url] so you can get all the details. Join us on the Trion Worlds team and have a fantastic time playing for a great cause!

notes.title: Status: Online - Patch - 11/3/2015 - 7AM PDT / 3 PM GMT
notes.content:
[IMG]http://webcdn.triongames.com/patcher/glyph-all/hotfix_trove.jpg[/IMG]

Update 1: We finished the patch an hour ahead of schedule and Trove is back online and ready to play. Thanks!

Hey folks!

We will be performing maintenance and rolling out the Movember Reign patch.

The servers will come down at [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7+AM+PDT+November+3+2015]7 AM PDT / 3 PM GMT[/URL] and expected down time is 3 hours. 

As always, we'll try to come in under that.

Thanks for your patience!

[B]==Features==[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Movember is live! Get your Movember pack from the Trove Store for 100 Cubits.
[*]50% Bonus Shadow Shards from the Shadow Tower chests
[*]The Fun Police Mag Rider is now on sale for only 500 Credits!
[*]Updates to the 'Static Storage' Neon City lair from Walyn
[*]The Chaos Chest has been updated! The top loot this week is the Radiant Steed.
[/LIST]

[B]Bug Fixes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed an issue where the Dance Pad would play the same music when traveling on the Mag Rail as when it was stationary
[*]Fixed an issue where physics would sometimes stop updating for character models 
[*]Fixed bug that caused incorrect Challenge to be generated at the daily reset time (2 AM PDT) 
[/LIST]

notes.title: Extra Life 2015 Details & Rewards - Prepare for Nov. 7!
notes.content:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2015/10/extra-life-blog.jpg[/IMG]

Greetings, Trovians! The Extra Life charity gaming marathon swiftly approaches! Every year, they raise millions of dollars for the Children’s Miracle Network Hospitals, and for five years running, we’ve done our part to support them.

Join us on [B]November 7th at 9am PDT [/B]for a 24 hour stream, featuring [B]all Trion Worlds games[/B]! You can support us by [URL=http://www.extra-life.org/index.cfm?fuseaction=register.start&eventID=525&teamID=23293]signing up for the Trion Team to help our fundraising[/URL]. Friends and family can sponsor your day of marathon gaming.

Of course, no good deed goes unrewarded: [URL=http://www.extra-life.org/team/trion]check out our Extra Life page[/URL] to see a list of goodies you can get for your hard work, also featured below!

[B]Extra Life 2015 Rewards[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Raise $15 in donations to get the [B]Dr. Qubesly ally[/B]!
[*]Raise $25 in donations and you’ll get the [B]Joystick ally[/B]!
[*]Raise $75  in donations to earn the [B]Arcade Helm[/B]!
[*]Raise $150 in donations and you’ll get a non-tradable [B]Chaos Coin[/B]!
[*]Everyone who raises an incredible $500 in donations will be entered into our Hero Drawing, and 25 Heroes (selected at random) will receive an amazing [B]25,000 Credits[/B]!
[/LIST]
You’ll also earn rewards in [B]ArcheAge[/B], [B]RIFT[/B],[B] Devilian [/B]and even [B]Atlas Reactor [/B]as you hit each milestone! [URL=http://extra-life.org/team/trion]Click here to learn more[/URL].

Not only all of that, but everyone who plays Trion games for a [B]combined total of 24 hours [/B]on the weekend of the 7th will receive a [B]non-tradable Flask Coin[/B] and a [B]non-tradable Inventory Expander (+5 adventure inventory slots, +5 build inventory slots)[/B]. Don’t miss out: the count starts at [B][URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=8+AM+PT+November+7+2015]8am PST on 11/7[/URL][/B] and ends at [B][URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=8+AM+PT+November+9+2015]8am PST on 11/9[/URL][/B]!

[B]Event Goodness[/B]

In addition to all those great rewards, if you donate via the [URL=http://www.extra-life.org/index.cfm?fuseaction=donorDrive.participant&participantID=176055]ExtraLife page of game designer Kumar ‘Atronos’ Daryanani[/URL] you can also help design items that will be added to Trove! Check out his page for details. 

Plus, we’ll be doing LIVE giveaways on the stream throughout the event. Join us on the Trion Worlds team and have a fantastic time playing for a great cause!

The Trion Extra Lifers

Everyone who raises an incredible $500 in donations will be entered into our Hero Drawing, and 25 Heroes (selected at random) will receive an amazing 25,000 Credits!
You’ll also earn rewards in ArcheAge, RIFT, Devilian and even Atlas Reactor as you hit each milestone!

Not only all of that, but everyone who plays Trion games for a combined total of 24 hours on the weekend of the 7th will receive a non-tradable Flask Coin and a non-tradable Inventory Expander (+5 adventure inventory slots, +5 build inventory slots).
In addition to all those great rewards, if you donate via the ExtraLife page of game designer Kumar ‘Atronos’ Daryanani you can also help design items that will be added to Trove!
Plus, we’ll be doing LIVE giveaways on the stream throughout the event.

notes.title: Resolved - Trove Offline - 10/30/2015
notes.content:
[IMG]http://webcdn.triongames.com/patcher/glyph-all/hotfix_trove.jpg[/IMG]

Update 7: We're back online! Thanks for your patience. Due to the extended downtime issues this week:
[LIST]
[*]Everyone who logs in this weekend (between 12AM PDT Saturday and 11:59 PM PDT Sunday) will receive a [B]free, non-tradable Class Coin [/B](which should come in handy with the Revenant coming up) [B]as well as 2,500 Cubits[/B].
[*]Everyone who was a Patron on Tuesday will have [B]a free day of Patron time[/B] applied to their account no later than tomorrow by 5PM PDT.
[/LIST]
[B]Update 6 (11:15 AM PDT / 6:15 PM GMT)[/B] - The team is in the process of restarting the servers so we can run some additional checks. We won't be allowing players in just yet, but I hope to have more info soon. I'll update this post in 1 hour, if we're not yet back online.

Update 5: We're bringing Trove offline again while we investigate the issue with the Player Marketplace. I don't have an estimate for when we will be back online just yet, but I will update this thread in one hour with any new info.

Update 4: The Player Marketplace is not allowing players to sell items, or collect payment for items they sold previously. We're working on this now, and hope to have more info very soon.

Update 3: We're back online! Thanks so much for your patience. Enjoy the rest of your day. 

Update 2: (9:30 AM PDT) We've located the issue, and are in the process of addressing it now. I'll post another update in 30 minutes.

Update 1: (8:30 AM PDT) Sorry for the late update, everyone. We're working to bring the servers back online. The team is working to investigate the delay, so please hang in there. I'll post another update in 1 hour, if we aren't already back online.

Hey folks!

We will be rolling out a quick hotfix on Friday.

The servers will come down at [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7+AM+PDT+October+30+2015]7 AM PDT / 2 PM GMT[/URL] and expected down time is 1 hour.

As always, we'll try to come in under that.

[B]Updates[/B]
[LIST]
[*]If your listed items have disappeared from the Marketplace, they should now reappear. (You'll need to free up empty slots to hold these items, then restart the game, if there are too many to display at once)
[*]Fixed a bug where Fae Tricksters and Dracolytes would sometimes appear not to be attacking to other players
 [*]Fixed a bug where Fae Tricksters and Dracolytes would not correctly show up to other players as mounted

notes.title: Test Your Mettle In The Battle Arena!
notes.content:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2015/10/blog-pvp-test.jpg[/IMG]

It’s trial by combat – The Trove Battle Arena needs YOU!

Join us today on the Public Test Server (PTS) at [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=2+PM+PDT+October+28+2015]2 PM PDT (10 PM GMT)[/URL] for an hour of stress testing on our upcoming Battle Arena system!

Log into the PTS and you’ll find a new, red portal in the Hub. Enter the portal and prepare to capture flags, fend off foes, and brawl with the best in fast-paced 4v4 combat. 

Note:
[list]
[*]You’ll need a max level character (20) on the live server to access the PTS. This week get 50% bonus XP, so it’s a great time to get max level and join us for the stress test!
[*]To download the PTS, launch Glyph and click the drop-down menu in the upper-right corner. Select PTS to download the test server client.
[*]In the Battle Arena, all characters scale to level, so no matter your level, you’re in it to win it!
[*]Each Battle Arena team consists of four players
[*]The goal is to capture the opposing team’s flag and bring it to your base
[/list] 
Come put arena battles to the test and face off against the toughest opponents of all: each other!

tags.feature: Enter the portal and prepare to capture flags, fend off foes, and brawl with the best in fast-paced 4v4 combat.

notes.title: Refer-A-Friend Update
notes.content:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2015/10/RAF_blog.jpg[/IMG]

Refer-A-Friend is getting supercharged! All this week you’ll get double Refer-A-Friend points for every new player you refer, so it’s the perfect time to introduce your friends to Trove! 

A look at the revamped program:
[LIST]
[*]Get double RAF points for all eligible accounts referred by November 3, 2015
[*]Earn 30 RAF points to receive the legendary dragon, Disaeon the Immortal!
[*]Referred accounts only need to reach Mastery Rank 20 (previously 30)
[*]Everyone you refer (prior to Mastery Rank 20) will receive a non-tradeable Class Coin to unlock any class!
[/LIST]
With the [url=http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/2015/10/28/refer-a-friend-update/]updated Refer-A-Friend system[/url], it’s easier to earn rewards with a little help from your friends!

notes.title: Patch - Bad to the Bone Edition - 10/27/2015 - 7AM PDT / 2 PM GMT
notes.content:
[IMG]http://webcdn.triongames.com/patcher/glyph-all/hotfix_trove.jpg[/IMG]

Hey folks!

We will be performing maintenance and rolling out [URL=http://forums.trovegame.com/showthread.php?77270]a patch[/URL].

The servers will come down at [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7+AM+PDT+October+27+2015]7 AM PDT / 2 PM GMT[/URL] and expected down time is 6 hours. 

As always, we'll try to come in under that.

Thanks for your patience!

[B]==Features==[/B]
[LIST]
[*]The [B]Bone Dragon[/B] has risen!
[*]Get [B]50% off classes[/B] from the Trove Store
[*]Level up faster with[B] 50% bonus experience[/B]!
[*]This week there are double the Invasions, and every Shadow Giant drops an [B]Eye of Q’bthulu[/B]
[/LIST]

[B]Game Update[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Randomized Chaos Chests! Get a [B]Store Meownt[/B], [B]Fox Mount[/B], or [B]Arcanium Discord Wings[/B]! 
[*]The Tomb Raiser ultimate ability now has an 8 second cooldown
[*]You can now purchase items using Credits or Cubits if Trove was started from Steam with the overlay disabled. 
[*]Basic attacks on ranged characters now move twice as fast
[*]Slight visual improvements to all tooltips.
[*]You can now destroy items in your inventory. It is bound to middle mouse button by default.
[/LIST]

[B]Player Marketplace[/B]
[LIST]
[*]You can now clear your previous search by clicking the X to the right of the search window
[*]Toggling 'Hide Collected' now also hides anything that cannot be collected
[*]Items now display their descriptions in the store
[*]Many marketplace server optimizations 
[*]You can now sort by unit price
[/LIST]

[B]Bug Fixes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed a bug where the max listing price in the Player Marketplace was 999,998 instead of 999,999 
[*]Fixed bug with activating loot collector while in build mode
[*]Club Log entries will display the correct timestamps
[*]Fixed Club Phones
[/LIST]

notes.title: New: Player Marketplace, Shadow's Eve, and Trove of Wonders!
notes.content:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2015/10/blog-economy.jpg[/IMG]

It's another huge week for Trove! We have a ton of new content, and bonuses for everyone!

The [b]Player Marketplace[/b] is available now! Press [b]U[/b] to access the Marketplace from anywhere, and buy and sell your goods to players all over the world! 

We're also thrilled to introduce the Trove of Wonders. This is a cache that can only be purchased using a full stack of Flux (a currency earned in game) from vendors on Golden Ships available in the Treasure Isles. These special caches hold a variety of items, including a chance at the most rare mounts in all of Trove
[list]
 [*]F4-S.T. Prototype Rocket – It may not pass an emissions test, but it passes the litmus test for awesome
 [*]Hadori, the Promise of Spring – Leaves a trail of flowers wherever she runs
 [*]Illuri of the North Wind – Transforms water into ice, temporarily, thus able to run on water
 [*]Kabiri, the Firetamer – Grants immunity to fire, and briefly transforms lava into standard blocks
 [*]Ganda the Sky Shepherd – This extremely rare bird of paradise turns air into gold, for a short time, allowing you to run through the heavens
 [*]Albairn, Voice of Dawn – Mechanical, magnificent, and melodious are great words to describe this powerful new dragon. You’ve never seen anything quite like this!
 [*]Fortras, the Herald of Battle – This gorgeous dragon wields tremendous power, and channels it into bombs that allow quick collection of blocks and ore
 [*]Turtle Tank – Not all turtles come equipped with a massive cannon, but this one does!
 [*]Royal Tortoise – This mount allows speedy transit across both land and sea
 [*]Radical Rainbow Wings – Carry a rainbow of colors with you wherever you go, and glide in style!
[/list]

Somehow there is even more stuff to talk about! Shadow's Eve starts today and brings a new look to the hub, as well as a moon makeover. There are also brand new Pumpkins Lairs that offer delicious Candy Corn for the Trovians willing to get squashed in the gourd.

This week, the first Challenge you complete each day with grant two guaranteed Dragon Coins! Stock up now, because the Moonwing Dragon is setting below the horizon next week!

Sky Realm rewards have been increased as well. This is a great week to stockpile Radiant Shards, Radiant Lockboxes, and fill out your collection of Nimbus mounts!

There is so much more to talk about, but don't take my word for it; log into Trove today, and see for yourself!

notes.title: Patch - 10/20/2015 - 7AM PDT / 2 PM GMT - Glim Life Update
notes.content:
[IMG]http://webcdn.triongames.com/patcher/glyph-all/hotfix_trove.jpg[/IMG]

Hey folks!

We will be performing maintenance and rolling out the Player Marketplace patch on Tuesday.

This is a huge update, so the servers will come down at  [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7+AM+PDT+October+20+2015]7 AM PDT / 2 PM GMT[/URL] and expected down time is 4 hours. 

As always, we'll try to come in under that.

Thanks for your patience!

== Features ==

[LIST]
[*]The [B]Player Marketplace[/B] is live! Press [B]U[/B] to open the Player Marketplace and sell your wares from anywhere.
[*]A [B]Trove of Wonders[/B] is available for one full stack of flux from the [B]Merchant of Marvels [/B]on the new Golden Ship vendors in Treasure Isles. Earn [B]Fragments of Wonder[/B] in these boxes and use them to buy new Flasks and Emblems from the Weaver of Wonders.
[*]These new boxes contain a variety of items, including Fragments of Wonder and may also contain many brand new, very rare mounts and wings: [B]F4-S.T. Prototype Rocket[/B]; [B]Hadori, the Promise of Spring[/B]; [B]Illuri of the North Wind[/B]; [B]Kabiri, the Firetamer[/B]; [B]Ganda the Sky Shepherd[/B]; [B]Turtle Tank[/B]; [B]Royal Tortoise[/B]; and [B]Radical Rainbow Wings[/B]!
[*]This week get [B]two[/B] Dragon Souls for your first Challenge of the day!
[*]For this week there are extra Sky Realm rewards – increased drop rate for [B]Nimbus[/B] mounts, [B]Radiant Shards[/B], and [B]Radiant Lockboxes[/B]
[/LIST]

[B]Shadow’s Eve[/B]
[LIST]
[*]The hub has a brand new look for [B]Shadow’s Eve[/B]
[*]A new set of Shadow's Eve Pumpkin Lairs are now in all adventure biomes. Created by Stedms and Tribe these give two Candy Corn per lair in addition to normal rewards!
[*][B]Autumn Piñatas[/B] give three [B]Candy Corn[/B] to the thrower and one to players in range all week!
[/LIST]

[B]Game Update[/B]
[LIST]
[*][B]Critical Hit[/B] replaces the Knockback stat on items, and determines how often you land a critical hit.
[*][B]Critical Damage[/B] is a new stat, and is the bonus multiplier when landing a crit.
[*]Use the [B]Adventurer’s Crafting Bench[/B] to combine a full stack of Flux into a [B]Megaflux Tank[/B]. 
[*]Megaflux Tanks can be converted back into a stack of Flux at an Adventurer's Crafting Bench.
[*]This week Chaos Chests may include no-trade [B]Chaos Coins[/B], a [B]Tome of Wonders[/B], plus other goodies!
[*]The Trading Post, Community Chest and Club Chests now requires mastery rank 5 to use. 
[*][B]Shadow Cache[/B], [B]Shaper's Dream[/B], [B]Shaper's Vision[/B], [B]Chaos Chests[/B], and [B]Troves of Wonders[/B] now all build up toward a guaranteed rare item after opening 70 boxes. To make up for this the chance for rare results from lockboxes has been reduced slightly. 
[*]Club World logs will now show when non-terrain blocks are destroyed in club worlds.
[*]Shadow Tower floors now have 3 arenas then the boss (down from 4). 
[*]Dragon mount projectiles now have a longer cooldown.
[/LIST]

[B]Trove Store[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Added a new 'Big Deal' that will sometimes show up in the store for $29.99 that includes Credits and a big pile of Shaper's Vision boxes.
[*]For a limited time, Cycle mounts are 50% off!
[/LIST]

[B]Call of Q'bthulhu[/B]
For this week only:
[LIST]
[*]The Chaos Forge randomizes all but the primary stat on an item!
[*]Tomes give 4x as many Tentacles of Q'bthulhu.
[*]Get [B]90% off Tentacles [/B]from the Trove Store!
[*]Invaders in Uber 5 always drop a Tentacles of Q'bthulhu while invaders from Uber 6 drop two.
[/LIST] 

[B]Bug Fixes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed a bug with ranged attacks. Attacks that look like they hit will now reliably register as hits.
[*]Tooltips again properly show when hovering over skills in the Character Sheet. 
[*]Fixed bug where you sometimes didn't spawn after entering an in-progress Shadow Tower 
[*]Fixed bug where boats got stuck when colliding with land instead of sliding against it 
[*]The profanity filter no longer applies to system messages. You will now know when you unlock an arsenal.
[/LIST]

We will be performing maintenance and rolling out the Double Oredition patch on Tuesday.

notes.title: The majestic Moonwing Dragon has come to Trove.
notes.content:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2015/09/blog6.jpg[/IMG]

Portended by the coming of the Super Blood Moon, the majestic [B]Moonwing Dragon[/B] enters Trove’s shattered realms today! Soar through the heavens atop the Moonwing brood, and quell the Shadow’s rising tide.

Use Dragon Souls, collected from [b]Moonwing Dragon Caches[/b], to power up this precious pet. Get these caches by completing Challenges, or from the Trove Store.

[list]
     [*]5 Dragon Souls- Unlock the Moonwing Dragonling ally
     [*]10 Dragon Souls – Earn the Moonwing Fledgling ground mount 
     [*]50 Dragon Souls – Take to the skies on the Moonwing Dragon gliding mount
     [*]75 Dragon Souls – Receive a permanent buff, Lunar Guidance, that grants [b]+5 Maximum Energy, +1 Jump, and +50 Magic Find[/b]. You’ll also unlock the [b]Moonlit Majesty[/b] weapon visual effect!
     [*]100 Dragon Souls – The legendary Syluria the Enchanting is yours to command
[/list] 

As the Moonwing Dragon brood waxes, the Ancient Dragon wanes. Those who long to soar the skies on the back of our previous dragons will still have a chance to obtain those legendary beasts through the use of [b]Dragon Coins[/b]!

You will not want to miss out on this gorgeous new dragon. With a guaranteed [B]Dragon Soul[/B] given for the first [B]Challenge[/B] completed every day, The legendary [B]Syluria the Enchanting[/B] is a total eclipse of the heart!

notes.title: Patch - Moonwing Rises Edition - 9/29/2015 - 7AM PDT / 2 PM GMT
notes.content:
[IMG]http://webcdn.triongames.com/patcher/glyph-all/hotfix_trove.jpg[/IMG]

Hey folks!

We will be performing maintenance and rolling out the Moonwing Rises patch!

The servers will come down at [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7+AM+PDT+September+29+2015]7 AM PDT / 2 PM GMT[/URL] and expected down time is 3 hours. 

As always, we'll try to come in under that.

Thanks for your patience!

[h1]Moonwing Dragon[/h1]
[list]
[*]Out with the Ancient, in with the Moonwing!
[*]Moonwing Dragon Caches are the new reward for completing Challenges.
Moonwing Dragon Caches can contain Flux, Dragon Coins, and Moonwing Dragon Souls.
[*]Moonwing Dragon Souls can be consumed to unlock Moonwing Dragon Ascension badges, viewable under the "Badges" tab on the "Collections" screen (Default key: Y)
[/list]
[h1]Chaos Week![/h1]
[list]
[*]Each Chaos Factor grants TWO daily Chaos Chests for this week!
[*]You can view your Chaos Factor by clicking "Stats" in the Character Sheet (Default Key: C)
[*]Squeakers the flying squirrel is back! Catch him in a chest while you can!
[*]The Santa Barbarian costume is in the chaos chest this week. Get festive.
[*]Chaos Chests now have Eyes at common and are more likely to result in eyes at uncommon.
[/list]
[h1]Adventure Week![/h1]
[list]
[*]Bonus week! 3x drop rate of Adventure Boxes and all previous boxes are coming out of retirement.
[/list]
[h1]Summer's End[/h1]
[list]
[*]Summer is coming to a close, and Summer Piñatas are all set to migrate to the Southern Hemisphere. For this week only, Summer Piñatas are 50% off! Get 'em now, because next week they'll be GONE.
[/list]
[h1]Patron Pass[/h1]
[list]
[*]Patron Pass now grants 4 chaos factor, up from 2.
[/list]
[h1]Shadow Tower[/h1]
[list]
[*]Killing Shadow Titans now spawns Chests which drop rare items and trophies!
[*]Shadow Cache now reward an additional eye on average most of the time. [*]The Eye Tome now grants 15 eyes up from 10 and the legendary one grants 400 eyes up from 300. The Shaper's Vision box now grants 3500 flux when it would have previously given 3000.
[*]Leaderboards now show the same rank for players with identical times
[*]The highest level boss available is now selected by default in the Shadow Tower UI
[/list]
[h1]Trades[/h1]
[list]
[*]Trading now uses a two-step confirmation system to prevent trade scams.
[*]Once your items are placed in the trading window, you need to 'Lock In' your trade.
[*]Once both players have 'Locked In' their trade, they can inspect each item to verify the trade is what they want before clicking 'Accept.' When both players have accepted the trade it will go through.
[*]If the player you are trading with changes their trade, then your 'Accept' is cancelled, and you will have to wait for them to 'Lock In' again before you can accept the new trade.
[/list]
[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added "Show Player Location" option in Settings>Miscellaneous. This will put coordinates above your Compass, showing you where you are in the current world.
[*]Enemies spawned by the Clone affix no longer get affixes themselves. This prevents invaders from exponentially spawning clones.
[*]Reduced the lifetime of clones and other affix adds from 60 seconds to 30 seconds.
[*]Fixed bug where consuming an item in your inventory that is split into multiple stacks consumed one item from each stack.
[*]/zzz is now zzz-ier
[*]/epicpose now hides player names
[*]Crafting windows now update status after crafting to correctly show recipes based on skill level and/or available resources.
[*]Combat Damage Numbers are now on by default. You can turn them off under Settings>Miscellaneous.
[*]Players with the Lunar Lancer unlocked will now unlock the starter weapon style.
[*]Added to Settings the option to invert camera for Controllers.
[*]Fixed bug where enemy health bars were sometimes blue.
[/list]
[h1]Player Creations & Styles[/h1]
[list]

notes.title: Patch - Moonwing Rises Edition - 9/29/2015 - 7AM PDT / 2 PM GMT
notes.content:
[IMG]http://webcdn.triongames.com/patcher/glyph-all/hotfix_trove.jpg[/IMG]

Hey folks!

We will be performing maintenance and rolling out the Moonwing Rises patch!

The servers will come down at [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7+AM+PDT+September+29+2015]7 AM PDT / 2 PM GMT[/URL] and expected down time is 3 hours. 

As always, we'll try to come in under that.

Thanks for your patience!

[h1]Moonwing Dragon[/h1]
[list]
[*]Out with the Ancient, in with the Moonwing!
[*]Moonwing Dragon Caches are the new reward for completing Challenges.
Moonwing Dragon Caches can contain Flux, Dragon Coins, and Moonwing Dragon Souls.
[*]Moonwing Dragon Souls can be consumed to unlock Moonwing Dragon Ascension badges, viewable under the "Badges" tab on the "Collections" screen (Default key: Y)
[/list]
[h1]Chaos Week![/h1]
[list]
[*]Each Chaos Factor grants TWO daily Chaos Chests for this week!
[*]You can view your Chaos Factor by clicking "Stats" in the Character Sheet (Default Key: C)
[*]Squeakers the flying squirrel is back! Catch him in a chest while you can!
[*]The Santa Barbarian costume is in the chaos chest this week. Get festive.
[*]Chaos Chests now have Eyes at common and are more likely to result in eyes at uncommon.
[/list]
[h1]Adventure Week![/h1]
[list]
[*]Bonus week! 3x drop rate of Adventure Boxes and all previous boxes are coming out of retirement.
[/list]
[h1]Summer's End[/h1]
[list]
[*]Summer is coming to a close, and Summer Piñatas are all set to migrate to the Southern Hemisphere. For this week only, Summer Piñatas are 50% off! Get 'em now, because next week they'll be GONE.
[/list]
[h1]Patron Pass[/h1]
[list]
[*]Patron Pass now grants 4 chaos factor, up from 2.
[/list]
[h1]Shadow Tower[/h1]
[list]
[*]Killing Shadow Titans now spawns Chests which drop rare items and trophies!
[*]Shadow Cache now reward an additional eye on average most of the time. [*]The Eye Tome now grants 15 eyes up from 10 and the legendary one grants 400 eyes up from 300. The Shaper's Vision box now grants 3500 flux when it would have previously given 3000.
[*]Leaderboards now show the same rank for players with identical times
[*]The highest level boss available is now selected by default in the Shadow Tower UI
[/list]
[h1]Trades[/h1]
[list]
[*]Trading now uses a two-step confirmation system to prevent trade scams.
[*]Once your items are placed in the trading window, you need to 'Lock In' your trade.
[*]Once both players have 'Locked In' their trade, they can inspect each item to verify the trade is what they want before clicking 'Accept.' When both players have accepted the trade it will go through.
[*]If the player you are trading with changes their trade, then your 'Accept' is cancelled, and you will have to wait for them to 'Lock In' again before you can accept the new trade.
[/list]
[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added "Show Player Location" option in Settings>Miscellaneous. This will put coordinates above your Compass, showing you where you are in the current world.
[*]Enemies spawned by the Clone affix no longer get affixes themselves. This prevents invaders from exponentially spawning clones.
[*]Reduced the lifetime of clones and other affix adds from 60 seconds to 30 seconds.
[*]Fixed bug where consuming an item in your inventory that is split into multiple stacks consumed one item from each stack.
[*]/zzz is now zzz-ier
[*]/epicpose now hides player names
[*]Crafting windows now update status after crafting to correctly show recipes based on skill level and/or available resources.
[*]Combat Damage Numbers are now on by default. You can turn them off under Settings>Miscellaneous.
[*]Players with the Lunar Lancer unlocked will now unlock the starter weapon style.
[*]Added to Settings the option to invert camera for Controllers.
[*]Fixed bug where enemy health bars were sometimes blue.
[/list]
[h1]Player Creations & Styles[/h1]
[list]
[*]New mask styles by Handsome_Jacques, DKMoore, Aodahn, billybeatable, PixelArtler, Paluche, BrianVI, Humpypants, Delvulria, ShiKilL, Knightlock, Stedms, necrocake, pixieNpixels, Pumkmine, Ampitere, AceGonzalez, Spectral_Force, Scheurmuis, DakotaSpine, Zwatchdog, Phantomizer, Topodic, GadgetCAT, Alaskan, Nyantaman, Silk, Qoaleth, Zilten, Acculluz, Dusty_Mustard, Indal, Karrut, L0rdkratos, CreepnChristian, GogestickCJ, yuhsiang4545, BforBrujah, HeavenlyDemon, HaruFenix, Xeof, Anzy, TheLiteralBest1, Forgive, NightSister, Pookii, Kevanxhu, Marton, Zimanta, Wiznet, and Punkshadow97 have been added to the game!
The appearance of the Ancient Shadowseeker bow from the Radiant Ruins was a duplicate and has been changed into a new style. You will however have to collect it again since our style-o-morphic tech isn't quiet ready.
[/list]
[h1]Mac[/h1]
[list]
[*]The Trove Store's Account Management button now directs your browser to account management on Mac.
[*]Fix Shadow Tower Leaderboards sometimes not populating on Mac.
Command+Tab now minimizes Trove when fullscreen to give you access to the desktop.
[*]Disabled fallback to software rendering on Mac clients when using features unsupported by the current graphics hardware or driver. This may result in a FPS increase for certain users but may cause visual artifacts for the same users.
[/list]

notes.title: Rise of the Shadow Tower Update is Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2015/09/TROVE_SHADOWTOWER_TN.jpg[/img]

Jealous of the luminous Sun Goddess, the Moon Goddess fuels the forces of darkness with her hatred and fear. The emboldened Shadow has taken refuge in the [b]Shadow Tower[/b], and threatens to spread, once again, across the realms.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nfc6OhoIPaE]Watch the Rise of the Shadow Tower trailer![/url]

Take the fight to the Shadow with our foxy new class: the [b]Lunar Lancer[/b]. Wield a spear to skewer your enemies and provide powerful buffs to your allies. Use your grappling hook to sneak up on foes, or when a hasty retreat becomes the better part of valor. Get all the necessaries in our [url=http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/2015/09/04/class-preview-the-lunar-lancer/]Lunar Lancer Preview[/url].

In addition to all of that, we’re also updating the way that Challenges work, we’ve added a bald hair option for your Trovian, added new Legendary Tomes that allow you to power them up, and collect major resources from them every week, added a ton of new player creations, and so much more! Get all the details with our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/304050/announcements/detail/786231969295950198]Rise of the Shadow Tower Patch Notes[/url].

notes.title: Rise of the Shadow Tower Update - 7 AM PDT / 2 PM GMT - September 15, 2015
notes.content:
[IMG]http://webcdn.triongames.com/patcher/glyph-all/hotfix_trove.jpg[/IMG]

Hey folks!

We will be performing maintenance and rolling out [URL=http://forums.trovegame.com/showthread.php?63828]the Rise of the Shadow Tower update[/URL]!

The servers will come down at [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7+AM+PDT+September+15+2015]7 AM PDT / 2 PM GMT[/URL] and expected down time is 3 hours. As always, we'll try to come in under that.

Thanks for your patience!

==Game UPDATE==

[b]Lunar Lancer is now live![/b]
[list]
[*]This fast and foxy fighter can throw spears and grapple to them, support their allies by dropping an area effect buff, and (while fighting) can transform into Lunatic mode – dishing out more damage and taking much less.
[*]An all-new weapon, the spear, is now live and available for the Lunar Lancer
[/list]

Lunacy Pack is now live!
[list]
[*]Pick up the Lunar Lancer, both costumes, two new mounts, and two store-bought legendary tomes at a deeply discounted price!
[/list]

Shadow Tower is now live!
[list]
[*]Use the Adventurer’s Crafting Bench to craft a Shadow Tower portal that can be placed in your Club World.
[*]Unlock normal mode using a Shadow Key, and unlock hard mode using the new Moon Key.
[*]Each Shadow Tower floor is made up of 4 Shadow Arenas, or Dungeons, followed by a Shadow Titan boss fight. Defeat each floor once a week for unique rewards in the form of Titan Souls and Lunar Souls (spent at the Shadowy Market at the end of each floor).
[*]Hard mode floors grant a 50% bonus to damage to any class that is the only one of its kind. This is reduced to 25% for two of the class and 0% if there are three, or more.
[*]Eyes of Q’Bthulhu earned from Shadow Caches increased slightly.
[*]The Shadow Tower has replaced standalone Shadow Arenas, thus Shadow Dungeons and the Shadow Lair no longer spawn.
[/list]

Legendary Tomes
[list]
[*]Legendary Tomes are now live. These tomes are worth 100 Mastery Points and can be triggered once a week for a large number of resources.
[*]Eye and Tentacle of Q’Bthulhu Legendary Tomes can be purchased with Lunar Souls
[*]Chaos Chest and Dragon Coin Legendary Tomes are available in the Trove Store.
[/list]

Deals Update
[list]
[*]Rotating deals now refresh hourly instead of daily
[*]There is no longer a $5 rotating deal and instead there are two $20 rotating deals
[*]There are new, rare rotating deals, including a class coin, inventory space, Golden Chaos Chests, and more!
[/list]

Challenge and Dragon Cache Update
[list]
[*]There is a new Ancient Dragon Cache which is now earned through challenges and on the Trove Store. This has 3 times as many Dragon Souls, 2.5 times as many Dragon Coins, no eyes of Q'Bthulhu and 35% less Flux.
[*]Previous Ancient Dragon Caches will now be called ‘Flux Filled Ancient Dragon Caches’ and remain unchanged.
[*]Challenges now only go up to rank 3 and completing this rank grants a full non-tradable Dragon Soul. Uber 6 now grants a 4X multiplier instead of 9X.
[/list]

Baldness
[list]
[*]Added a bald hairstyle to the barbershop! Go take off all that nasty hair! Designed by Mr. E.
[/list]

Additional Updates and Fixes
[list]
[*]Origin portals can no longer be opened in the Shadow Tower
[*]There is now a new set of Neophyte's Wings earned at Mastery rank 10 that are slower than other wings in the game. The previous Neophyte's wings are now Adept’s Wings and are earned at mastery rank 40.

notes.title: Preview – Rise of the Shadow Tower
notes.content:
[img]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2015/09/TROVE_ACT_ShadowTowerBoss_03.jpg[/img]

Shadow Arenas are evolving with the [b]Rise of the Shadow Tower[/b] update. Take the fight against the forces of darkness to a whole new level in the perilous Shadow Tower!

Test your mettle as you fight your way to the tower’s peak by defeating an onslaught of powerful new enemies: the [b]Shadow Titans[/b]! Once you reach the top level, you’ll face off against the [b]Daughter of the Moon[/b]; the toughest enemy ever to darken the Trovian landscape.

Here are just some of the Shadow Titans you’ll encounter:
[list]
[*]Spike Walker – A massive mechanical monster with powerful spike attacks.
[*]Weeping Prophet – This towering fiend only has eyes for you. The downside is that these eyes want to shoot blazing lasers at your face.
[*]Piñata God – Too long have Trovians attacked innocent piñatas without remorse or consequence. It’s payback time! Beware this sugary savior – brutal stomp attacks and deadly confetti breath are just a taste of what this papier-mâché powerhouse can do.
[/list]
The Shadow Hydra (a powerful boss created by a Trove player, FriedSushi, and [url=http://triongam.es/1hociPM]voted on by the community[/url]) will make its debut in the Shadow Tower in an update coming soon.

Get ready to fight the looming shadow in a whole new way, when the Shadow Tower rises on [b]September 15[/b]!

notes.title: Patch Notes: 8/25/2015 - Chaotic Sugar Glider & Strike A Pose Edition!
notes.content:
[img]http://webcdn.triongames.com/patcher/glyph-all/hotfix_trove.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

We will be performing maintenance, and rolling out a patch on 8/25/2015. 

The servers will come down at 7 AM PDT / 2 PM GMT and should be down for approximately 3 hours. 

As always, we'll try to come in under that.

[B]Twice the Chaos![/B]

[LIST]
[*]For this week only the number of Chaos Chests granted daily through your Chaos Factor has been DOUBLED.

[*]Additionally, the Chaos Chest’s contents have been shuffled! This week's top prize? Squeakers!
[/LIST]

[B]Squeakers the Sugar Glider![/B]

[LIST]
[*]Do you like cute things? Of course you do, you're no monster! Appearing in Chaos Chests this week is Squeakers is a Sugar Glider mount, able to run on the ground and glide in the sky like dragons! (Note: Squeakers does not like fire, do not attempt to get him/her to shoot fireballs).

[*]Squeakers will appear in the Chaos Chest for one week, but he (or she) will return to the game in some other fashion in the very near future!
[/LIST]

[B]Tradable Patron Pass[/B]

[LIST]
[*]You can now purchase a version of the 30 Day Patron Pass which can be traded or gifted to other players!

[*]Once consumed, the 30 days are locked to that account.

[*]Remember, you can check your patron status by looking for the Patron Icon, to the left of your Mastery Rank in your character sheet (default key: C).
[/LIST]

[B]/epicpose[/B]

[LIST]
[*]You can now type /epicpose to get some sweet camera angles to show off your mount & gear, and whatever world you're in!

[*]Screenshots taken though /epicpose are placed in Trove folder within the Documents folder for the current user

[*]IE: C:\users\[user name]\My Documents\Trove\
[/LIST]

[B]Intro Video![/B]

[LIST]
[*]Trove now has an intro video, detailing some of Trove’s lore and backstory!

[*]It only plays once because we understand how precious your milliseconds are.

[*]If you want to view it again, perhaps because in your excitement you slammed your face into the keyboard and didn’t get to finish watching it, you can re-enable it by checking: Settings>Miscellaneous>Play Intro Movies
[/LIST]

[B]Misc[/B]

[LIST]
[*]Sails: Foolish Fish, Inner Sea, Much Sail, Raider Sail, Bee Sail and Ladybug Sail should correctly unlock their respective sails now.

[*]Added footprints to the following Raptor and Bird mounts: Blue Budgie, Pink Budgie, Robo Raptor, Holiday Raptor, Fancy Raptor, Friend Raptor.

[*] Fix for modifier keys not displayed in Settings -> Controls when used with a mouse button.

[*] You can now bind mouse wheel up or down to any action.

[*] Build Mode rotate placement now defaults to Shift + mouse wheel up & shift + mouse wheel down.

[*] You can now click “OK” immediately after having pasted a name into the “Add Friend” input.

[*]The dropdown menus in Settings>Video now show their contents immediately (previously they didn’t show up until you hovered the mouse over them).

[*]Tomb Raiser's Banshee's Boon damage aura should no longer flicker erratically.

[*]Inventory icons no longer appear reversed when using OpenGL for rendering.

[*]Dangling pointer fix (I don’t know what this means, but it’s fun to say!)

[/LIST]

notes.title: Trophy Fish Make a Splash in Trove
notes.content:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2015/08/fishing1.png[/IMG]

Let’s dive right into the aquatic adventure that is fishing. Trophy Fish are decorations that you can place in your Cornerstone or Club World when you’re angling to spruce up the joint (if you catch my drift). Did you think we were all trout of puns? Not on your life!

[LIST]
[*]Average – The standard size of fish you’ve always been able to catch in Trove.
[*]Trophy – The first tier of Trophy Fish.
[*]Silver Trophy – Less common than your average Trophy Fish, Silver is a heavier weight class.
[*]Gold Trophy – This is the heaviest weight, and rarest of all trophy types.
[/LIST]


If placed in the Loot Collector, any type of Trophy Fish will deconstruct into a trophy. After catching a trophy, release it into your Cornerstone (or Club World) by swapping to build mode, and placing it like you would any block. Other Trovians will see a tooltip that shows the weight of each trophy. The heavier the fish, the greater the bragging rights.

Quit seahorsing around, because these trophies are off the hook. Adventure your way to the Trophy Fish pantheon, just for the halibut!

notes.title: Tuesday Patch: Fat Fish & Flashy FX Edition - 8/11/15 7 AM PDT / 2 PM GMT
notes.content:
[IMG]http://webcdn.triongames.com/patcher/glyph-all/hotfix_trove.jpg[/IMG]

Hello everyone!

We will be performing maintenance, and rolling out the Fat Fish & Flashy FX Edition patch on 8/11/2015. 

The expected downtime of 4 hours will begin at [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7+AM+PDT+August+11+2015] 7 AM PDT / 2 PM GMT[/URL].

As always, we'll try to come in under that.

[b]FEATURES[/b]
FISHING TROPHIES
[LIST]
[*]Fish now have weights, so now you can-have-once caught one thiiiiiiiiiiis big!
[*]The heaviest fish of a given type count as a TROPHY CATCH, which can be deconstructed in to Bronze, Silver, or Gold trophies to place in your Cornerstone or Club World!
[/LIST]

AURAS UPDATE
[LIST]
[*]Three New VFX for your Radiant Weapons are now available!
[*]Neon - Available after unlocking 50 Neon Dragon Souls.
[*]Shadow Stain - dropped rarely when adventuring.
[*]Tough Love - dropped rarely when adventuring.
[*]Changing Radiant Auras at the Enchanted Forge now goes through them all in order, rather than choosing one randomly.
[*]You can now view the auras you have unlocked in the Collections window (Default key: Y) under Styles>Radiant Auras.
[/LIST]
[b]GAME UPDATE[/b]
NEW IN THE STORE
[LIST]
[*]Chaos Chest rewards been shuffled! Get your hands on the HOT Torched Taurus, submitted by Screamheart!
[*]Sorcerous Servant emblem has been added to the store! Are you Sorcerous? Do you want a Servant? WE'VE GOT A FLASK EMBLEM FOR YOU!
[*]Clicking "Get Chaos Chests" on the Trove Today screen will now open up a store page that shows nothing except chaos chests! How simple!
[/LIST]


KEYBINDINGS
[LIST]
[*]Using the mouse wheel when in build mode no longer rotates placed objects, and now zooms just like adventure mode. 
[*]Holding Shift while pressing the middle mouse button will rotate objects. 
[*]"Walk" in build mode, previously bound to the shift key, is now bound to the control key.
[/LIST]


ADVENTURING
[LIST]
[*]"Nova" bosses now fire shots in a half circle in front of themselves rather than all around themselves.
[/LIST]


CLASSES
[LIST]
[*]Player-summoned objects (Tomb Raiser's minions, Dracolyte's Burnt Offering, etc.) are now destroyed when changing classes.
[/LIST]


BUG FIXES AND POLISH
[LIST]
[*]Attempting to loot items with your inventory open will no longer claim you don't have space
[*]You can now right click a player's name when they chat in /say (this actually happened last week!)
[*]Fixed a few crashes related to Particle Effects.

[*]Fixed some video setting changes not saving if the screen resolution was changed at the same time.
[/LIST]


COMMUNITY CREATIONS
[LIST]
[*]New hairstyles by GadgetCAT, Humpypants, Dragoes, Narwiff, Zoe, PinkNekoGirl, and AtomicHoagie have been added to the game! 
[*]Desert Frontier NPCs now drop the appropriate trophies, courtesy of Tribe!
[/LIST]

notes.title: Status - Online - Maintenance - 7 AM PDT / 2 PM GMT - Tuesday, August 4, 2015
notes.content:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2015/07/launch_blog_header-720x3221.jpg[/IMG]

Update: We're back online! Thanks again, everyone.

Hello everyone!

We will be performing maintenance, and rolling out a patch, on 8/4/2015. 

The servers will come down at [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7+AM+PDT+August+4+2015] 7 AM PDT / 2 PM GMT[/URL]. We anticipate downtime being approximately 4 hours, but will keep this post updated if we need more time, or bring the servers back online early.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
INVENTORY EXPANSION
[LIST]
[*]You can now add up to 105 additional slots to both your adventure and build inventories!
[*]Open your inventory and look at the bottom, click the + to unlock that row. This will unlock that row in BOTH adventure and build inventory bags!
[*]Once all rows in a given bag are unlocked, you can click on the next bag to access additional slots.
[*]You can also find tradable Inventory Unlockers in the store under the Goods tab!
[*]SALE! For the first week, unlocking inventory is half price! This only applies to unlocks performed through the inventory UI itself, not to the tradable items.
[/LIST]

STARTER PACK UPGRADE
[LIST]
[*]Two Inventory Expander items have been added to the Starter Pack.
[*]Players who previously purchased a Starter Pack will retroactively been granted two of these items. <3!
[/LIST]

COMBAT NUMBERS!
[LIST]
[*]Ever wonder how awesome that new weapon you just picked up was? Now you can! Go into Settings>Miscellaneous and check "Show Combat Numbers" to see how much damage you're doing!
[/LIST]

[h1]Game Update[/h1]

GENERAL
[LIST]
[*]Player summoned objects and minions now show an outline when on the other side of a wall.
[*]Players now correctly get magic find bonus when their minions kills an enemy.
[/LIST]

NEW IN THE STORE
[LIST]
[*]Chaos Chests have been randomized! Get lucky, and you might get your hands on the Cygnus-01 Speedcycle!
[/LIST]

UI AND SETTINGS
[LIST]
[*]Your Patron Status can now be viewed at the top of your character sheet.
[*]Tooltips now properly update when right clicking an item to equip it from your inventory. Yay!
[*]Fixed a bug where the mouse wasn't recaptured if you activated the chat while holding Alt.
[*]In the settings menu, reverting from fullscreen/fullscreen windowed mode back to windowed mode will correctly restore the original window size and position.
[/LIST]

BUG FIXES AND POLISH
[LIST]
[*]Trove will no longer hide behind start bars, or off-screen where you can't grab it. 
[*]The Trove window now has a minimum size.
[*]You can no longer make Steam Wallet purchases when running Steam in Offline Mode.
[*]The Fireside Pemburr Pup should now be visible and working.
[*]The "Red Flag" and "Skull Flag" Treasure Island recipes no longer float off of the walls onto which you place them.
[*]The Flames on the Blue, Red, and Yellow Neon City Lanterns are no longer floating in the wrong place.
[*]Fixed a bug when aiming at spikes could cause wild projectile shots.
[*]Fix a bug where using an ability while dancing makes you appear to use the ability while dancing to other players. Now you see yourself dancing while using the ability, too! (Also works with other emotes.)
[*]Lobber traps no longer damage NPCs.
[*]Some light-stepping cats have gotten paw prints!
[*]Fixed bug where Homeworld Heart tooltip didn't show mastery level requirements when you were below that level.
[/LIST]

COMMUNITY CREATIONS
New bow styles by WolfTech, CatThatFromTheHell, Aodahn, Jorty_B, Kopros, barryscott, Haosi, necrocake, N1ghtmarePT, Aey and Choczy have been added to the game!

New pistol styles by Knightlock, Yeronix, Stedms, ASGNeoN, Eriri, Aey, Techonrye, and Kill3rCreeper have been added to the game!

New Staff styles by Weemuddy, IamKolten, BrianVI, MappyT, TheWookieOfDoom, Aey, Arik4shin, AdamantSpartan, Sheribonbon, blattoidae, Fiuza, and Ocgineer have been added to the game!

New decor by Xeviar, illand, IcyAngel, Mythlit, Eriri, Woofbottoms, Irvaxis, Qoaleth, Slinthas, Khastiel, mamagabby, Insaint, Pufflebump, Market, Ocgineer, Volfide, ReshiramFury, EyeballPrincessII, Talitharine, MoganFR, PsicoVoxeL, GadgetCAT, Stedms, and ffgamen have been added to the game!

Thanks for your patience!

notes.title: UPDATE 2: Patch - Lack of Class (Changers) Edition - 7 AM PDT (-7 GMT) 7/28/2015
notes.content:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2015/07/launch_blog_header-720x3221.jpg[/IMG]

Update 2: The updates that we're rolling out to speed up future patches are moving along, but are still in progress. Please bear with us. We expect to have Trove back online at approximately 2 PM PDT / 9 PM GMT, but will do our very best to be back online earlier.

Update: We're taking extra steps this week so that future patches will go much more quickly. While we're [b]extending today's down time for about 1 hour[/b], future patches should go more quickly.

Hello everyone!

We will be performing maintenance and rolling out a patch on 7/28/2015. 

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

GENERAL
[LIST]
[*]Pinatas should no longer get pushed around by Tomb Raiser minions. 
[*]Most items now have a notification when dropping them on the ground. Boots do not. 
[*]Fixed a server crash caused by NPCs moving outside of the world, breaking time and space itself.
[/LIST]

FRIENDS LIST
[LIST]
[*]You can now send friend requests to offline users.
[*]The friends list now sorts incoming friend requests to the top of the list.
[/LIST]


NEW IN THE STORE
[LIST]
[*]Chaos Chests have been randomized. You meow have a chance to find Ari Gato, Domo Gato, or Daimeownt when opening Chaos Chests. Here's hoping you're furtunate to get one of these clawesome new mounts!
[*]The new costume pack, To The Nines, is now available!
[*]The Tomb Raiser pack is no longer available. Did you miss it? Never fear! The Boneweaver and Spite Biter Spider Mounts, and Soulfire Wings are now available on the store!
[*]The Arcanium Steamboat, Crawler Mount, and Discord Wings are now available for purchase on the store!
[/LIST]

[b]CLASSES[/b]

NEON NINJA
[LIST]
[*]Stasis Blade no longer snares minions. Be free, minions! Be free!
[/LIST]
PIRATE CAPTAIN
[LIST]
[*]Using the First Mate ability while against a wall no longer spawns the minion at the top of the wall.
[/LIST]

UI AND SETTINGS
[LIST]
[*]World tooltips now tilt so that players can read them more easily. 
[*]Added an exit button to the Connecting/Queue screen, plus some other visual polish touches.
[*]The challenge UI now shows up in club worlds.
[/LIST]

BUG FIXES AND POLISH
[LIST]
[*]Left click while on a legendary dragon while not flying will now dismount you like all other mounts. 
[*]Fixed a bug where spamming the mount keys resulted in the player appearing to have two mounts active simultaneously.
[*]Fixed an issue where the earring on the Bounteous Hunter hairstyle wasn't masked correctly.
[*]Updated the visuals for the Enchanted Forge and regular Forge.
[*]Fixed a bug where the red placement target wouldn't change to white (or vice versa) until targeting a new block.
[*]Fixed a bug causing the Sky Realm appeared as "Rank 5 Shadow Arena" on friends list and invitations.
[*]Fixed a bug causing some Winter items to yield a fifth "unknown" stat when upgrading. 
[*]Fixed a bug causing the Highlands recipe for the Dusty Bookcase to incorrectly point to the Well-Loved Bookcase instead.
[/LIST]


The servers will come down at [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7+AM+PDT+July+28+2015] 7 AM PDT / 2 PM GMT[/URL] and should be down for approximately 5 hours. 

As always, we'll try to come in under that.

Thanks for your patience!
